AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Custom AWS Systems Manager Automation solution aligned with the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
  control for VPC flow logging. The stack creates a CloudWatch Logs log group that retains VPC
  Flow Log records for seven years, an IAM role that VPC Flow Logs and Systems Manager Automation
  can assume to write flow log records to that log group and manage EC2 flow log resources, a
  separate privileged Systems Manager Automation execution role, and two Automation runbooks: one
  that enables VPC Flow Logs with reject traffic capture on a VPC supplied at execution time, and
  a dependent runbook that routes the same remediation through AWS Systems Manager Change Manager
  as a formal change request before delegating the identical flow log remediation to the first
  runbook.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: vpc-flow-logs
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    Description: Value applied to the Project tag of every resource created by this template.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
      - staging
      - dev
    Description: Value applied to the Environment tag of every resource created by this template.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flow log destination
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      # VPC Flow Logs delivered to CloudWatch Logs are encrypted with service-side encryption,
      # so no customer managed KMS key is attached to this log group.
      # 2557 days = 7 years retention, which is appropriate for compliance records.
      RetentionInDays: 2557
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-VPC-FlowLogs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by VPC Flow Logs delivery (logs.amazonaws.com) and by Systems Manager
  # Automation (ssm.amazonaws.com) to manage flow log resources for a VPC.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlog-delivery-role'
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by the VPC Flow Logs delivery service to publish flow log records into the
        CloudWatch Logs log group created by this template, and by Systems Manager Automation so
        the runbooks in this template can create, describe and delete EC2 flow log resources that
        use that log group.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsDeliveryService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowSystemsManagerAutomation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeliverFlowLogsToTemplateLogGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogRecordsOnlyToTemplateLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
        - PolicyName: ManageVpcFlowLogResources
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageFlowLogsForVpcs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassOnlyThisFlowLogDeliveryRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flowlog-delivery-role'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-VPC-FlowLogs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Intentionally privileged Systems Manager Automation execution role. This is distinct from the
  # flow log delivery role and carries the broad permissions the automation steps require.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-automation-execution-role'
      Description: >-
        Privileged execution role assumed by the Systems Manager Automation documents created by
        this template. It carries the broad permissions the runbook steps need to create, describe
        and delete VPC flow logs, write flow log records to the CloudWatch Logs log group, submit
        Change Manager change requests and start the delegated remediation runbook.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSystemsManagerAutomation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsAutomationPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageVpcFlowLogsAcrossTheAccount
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeRegions
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogRecordsToTemplateLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
              - Sid: PassFlowLogDeliveryAndExecutionRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogDeliveryRole.Arn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${AWS::StackName}-automation-execution-role'
              - Sid: RunDelegatedRunbooksAndChangeRequests
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationStepExecutions
                  - ssm:StartChangeRequestExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                  - ssm:ListDocuments
                  - ssm:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-VPC-FlowLogs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Runbook 1: enables VPC Flow Logs with reject traffic capture on a VPC supplied at execution time.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-enable-vpc-flow-logs'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-VPC-FlowLogs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables VPC Flow Logs that capture reject traffic on the VPC supplied at automation
          execution time and delivers the flow log records to the CloudWatch Logs log group created
          by this template. This runbook implements the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark control that
          requires VPC flow logging to be enabled for the environment.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: >-
              ID of the VPC to enable VPC Flow Logs on. This value is supplied when the automation
              is started; this template does not create or reference any VPC resource.
            allowedPattern: '^vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
          TrafficType:
            type: String
            description: Type of traffic that the flow log captures. Defaults to REJECT traffic.
            default: REJECT
            allowedValues:
              - ACCEPT
              - REJECT
              - ALL
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: >-
              Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the flow log records. Defaults to
              the log group created by this template.
            default: !Ref FlowLogGroup
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableVpcFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: >-
              Describes the existing flow logs for the VPC and creates a cloud-watch-logs flow log
              that captures reject traffic, unless an equivalent flow log already targets the VPC
              and the log group.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                TrafficType: '{{ TrafficType }}'
                LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
                DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogDeliveryRole.Arn
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def handler(event, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    vpc_id = event['VpcId']
                    traffic_type = event.get('TrafficType') or 'REJECT'
                    log_group_name = event['LogGroupName']
                    deliver_logs_permission_arn = event['DeliverLogsPermissionArn']

                    existing_flow_logs = ec2.describe_flow_logs(
                        Filters=[
                            {'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]},
                            {'Name': 'log-destination-type', 'Values': ['cloud-watch-logs']},
                        ]
                    ).get('FlowLogs', [])

                    for flow_log in existing_flow_logs:
                        if flow_log.get('LogGroupName') == log_group_name:
                            return {
                                'FlowLogId': flow_log['FlowLogId'],
                                'FlowLogCreated': 'false',
                                'TrafficType': flow_log.get('TrafficType', traffic_type),
                                'Message': 'An existing flow log already targets VPC {0} with log group {1}.'.format(vpc_id, log_group_name),
                            }

                    create_response = ec2.create_flow_logs(
                        ResourceIds=[vpc_id],
                        TrafficType=traffic_type,
                        LogDestinationType='cloud-watch-logs',
                        LogGroupName=log_group_name,
                        DeliverLogsPermissionArn=deliver_logs_permission_arn,
                    )

                    unsuccessful = create_response.get('Unsuccessful') or []
                    if unsuccessful:
                        raise RuntimeError('Failed to create the VPC flow log: {0}'.format(unsuccessful))

                    flow_log_ids = create_response.get('FlowLogIds') or []
                    if not flow_log_ids:
                        raise RuntimeError('The ec2:CreateFlowLogs call returned no flow log ID.')

                    return {
                        'FlowLogId': flow_log_ids[0],
                        'FlowLogCreated': 'true',
                        'TrafficType': traffic_type,
                        'Message': 'Created flow log {0} for VPC {1}.'.format(flow_log_ids[0], vpc_id),
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: FlowLogId
                Selector: $.Payload.FlowLogId
                Type: String
              - Name: FlowLogCreated
                Selector: $.Payload.FlowLogCreated
                Type: String
              - Name: TrafficType
                Selector: $.Payload.TrafficType
                Type: String
              - Name: Message
                Selector: $.Payload.Message
                Type: String
        outputs:
          - EnableVpcFlowLogs.FlowLogId
          - EnableVpcFlowLogs.FlowLogCreated
          - EnableVpcFlowLogs.TrafficType
          - EnableVpcFlowLogs.Message

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Runbook 2: submits the same remediation as a formal Systems Manager Change Manager change
  # request for approval and then delegates the flow log remediation to runbook 1.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcFlowLogsChangeManagerDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs-change-manager'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: CIS-VPC-FlowLogs
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Routes the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark VPC flow logging remediation through AWS Systems
          Manager Change Manager. The runbook first submits the remediation as a formal change
          request and then delegates the identical flow log remediation to the dependency runbook
          created by this template so the flow log logic is not duplicated.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: >-
              ID of the VPC to enable VPC Flow Logs on. This value is supplied when the automation
              is started; this template does not create or reference any VPC resource.
            allowedPattern: '^vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
          TrafficType:
            type: String
            description: Type of traffic that the flow log captures. Defaults to REJECT traffic.
            default: REJECT
            allowedValues:
              - ACCEPT
              - REJECT
              - ALL
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: >-
              Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the flow log records. Defaults to
              the log group created by this template.
            default: !Ref FlowLogGroup
          # Change Manager is not exposed as a first-class Automation action, so the change request
          # is submitted by calling the Systems Manager Change Manager API (StartChangeRequestExecution)
          # from an aws:executeScript step. StartChangeRequestExecution requires the name of an
          # Automation.ChangeTemplate change template that exists in the account and Region; AWS does
          # not guarantee a public default change template. If the default below is not present in
          # this account and Region, create a change template in Change Manager and pass its name, or
          # the SubmitChangeRequest step fails with the service error returned by Change Manager.
          ChangeTemplateDocumentName:
            type: String
            description: >-
              Name of the Systems Manager Change Manager change template (an SSM document of type
              Automation.ChangeTemplate) that governs approval of the change request.
            default: AWS-ChangeManagerChangeTemplate
        mainSteps:
          - name: SubmitChangeRequest
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: >-
              Submits the flow log remediation as a formal Change Manager change request that must
              be approved. The change request runs the dependency runbook of this template after it
              is approved.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                TrafficType: '{{ TrafficType }}'
                LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
                ChangeTemplateDocumentName: '{{ ChangeTemplateDocumentName }}'
                RunbookDocumentName: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument
                ProjectName: !Ref ProjectName
                ChangeRequestPrefix: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-enable-vpc-flow-logs'
              Script: |-
                import datetime

                import boto3


                def handler(event, context):
                    ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

                    vpc_id = event['VpcId']
                    traffic_type = event.get('TrafficType') or 'REJECT'
                    log_group_name = event['LogGroupName']
                    runbook_document_name = event['RunbookDocumentName']
                    change_template_document_name = event['ChangeTemplateDocumentName']
                    change_request_prefix = event['ChangeRequestPrefix']

                    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
                    change_request_name = '{0}-{1}'.format(change_request_prefix, now.strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M%S'))

                    response = ssm.start_change_request_execution(
                        ChangeRequestName=change_request_name,
                        ChangeDetails='Enable VPC Flow Logs with reject traffic capture on VPC {0} (CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark VPC flow logging control).'.format(vpc_id),
                        DocumentName=change_template_document_name,
                        AutoApprove=False,
                        Runbooks=[
                            {
                                'DocumentName': runbook_document_name,
                                'Parameters': {
                                    'VpcId': [vpc_id],
                                    'TrafficType': [traffic_type],
                                    'LogGroupName': [log_group_name],
                                },
                            },
                        ],
                        Tags=[
                            {'Key': 'Project', 'Value': event['ProjectName']},
                            {'Key': 'Compliance', 'Value': 'CIS-VPC-FlowLogs'},
                        ],
                    )

                    return {
                        'ChangeRequestName': change_request_name,
                        'ChangeRequestAutomationExecutionId': response.get('AutomationExecutionId', ''),
                        'ChangeTemplateDocumentName': change_template_document_name,
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: ChangeRequestName
                Selector: $.Payload.ChangeRequestName
                Type: String
              - Name: ChangeRequestAutomationExecutionId
                Selector: $.Payload.ChangeRequestAutomationExecutionId
                Type: String
              - Name: ChangeTemplateDocumentName
                Selector: $.Payload.ChangeTemplateDocumentName
                Type: String
          - name: DelegateRemediation
            action: aws:executeAutomation
            description: >-
              Delegates the flow log remediation to the dependency runbook created by this template
              so the same flow log logic performs the change instead of duplicating it here. The
              runbook is referenced by its CloudFormation logical ID, which makes this document
              depend on the other document.
            inputs:
              DocumentName: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument
              RuntimeParameters:
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                TrafficType: '{{ TrafficType }}'
                LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
        outputs:
          - SubmitChangeRequest.ChangeRequestName
          - SubmitChangeRequest.ChangeRequestAutomationExecutionId
          - SubmitChangeRequest.ChangeTemplateDocumentName

Outputs:
  FlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives VPC Flow Log records.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup
  FlowLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives VPC Flow Log records.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
  FlowLogDeliveryRoleArn:
    Description: >-
      ARN of the IAM role assumed by VPC Flow Logs delivery and by Systems Manager Automation to
      manage flow log resources.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogDeliveryRole.Arn
  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the privileged Systems Manager Automation execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
  EnableVpcFlowLogsDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the Automation runbook that enables VPC Flow Logs with reject capture.
    Value: !Ref EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument
  EnableVpcFlowLogsDocumentArn:
    Description: ARN of the Automation runbook that enables VPC Flow Logs with reject capture.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${EnableVpcFlowLogsDocument}'
  VpcFlowLogsChangeManagerDocumentName:

    Description: ARN of the Automation runbook that routes the remediation through Change Manager.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:document/${VpcFlowLogsChangeManagerDocument}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless WebSocket API (Amazon API Gateway v2) whose $default route asynchronously starts an
  AWS Step Functions STANDARD state machine. The state machine waits five seconds and then posts a
  response back to the connected WebSocket client through the API Gateway Management API.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    Description: >-
      Name of the WebSocket API stage. Used by the deployment, by the API Gateway Management API
      callback URL the state machine calls, and by the state machine IAM policy.

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # WebSocket API
  ##############################################################################
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  ##############################################################################
  # IAM role assumed by API Gateway so the $default route can start executions
  ##############################################################################
  ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartWebSocketWorkflowExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${AWS::StackName}-websocket-workflow'

  ##############################################################################
  # Step Functions state machine that answers the WebSocket client
  ##############################################################################
  WorkflowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-websocket-workflow'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  WebSocketWorkflowRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostResponsesToWebSocketConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageWebSocketConnections
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/POST/@connections/*'
              - Sid: WorkflowExecutionLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                Resource: '*'

  WebSocketWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-workflow'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt WebSocketWorkflowRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt WorkflowLogGroup.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Preserve the connection id and message, wait five seconds, then post the response back to the connected WebSocket client.",
          "StartAt": "PrepareResponse",
          "States": {
            "PrepareResponse": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Parameters": {
                "connectionId.$": "$.connectionId",
                "message.$": "$.message",
                "response": {
                  "connectionId.$": "$.connectionId",
                  "message.$": "$.message",
                  "status": "delivered"
                }
              },
              "Next": "WaitFiveSeconds"
            },
            "WaitFiveSeconds": {
              "Type": "Wait",
              "Seconds": 5,
              "Next": "PostToConnection"
            },
            "PostToConnection": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:apigatewaymanagementapi:postToConnection",
              "Parameters": {
                "ApiEndpoint": "https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}",
                "ConnectionId.$": "$.connectionId",
                "Data.$": "States.JsonToString($.response)"
              },
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  ##############################################################################
  # Direct (asynchronous, fire-and-forget) WebSocket integration to Step Functions.
  # Explicit AWS service integration on the plain StartExecution action. The whole
  # StartExecution request body (stateMachineArn + input) is produced by the VTL
  # request template, so no RequestParameters mapping expressions are needed.
  ##############################################################################
  WebSocketStepFunctionsIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole.Arn
      RequestTemplates:
        application/json: !Sub |
          {
            "stateMachineArn": "${WebSocketWorkflow}",
            "input": "{\"connectionId\":\"$context.connectionId\",\"message\":$util.escapeJavaScript($input.body)}"
          }

  ##############################################################################
  # $default route: every inbound message starts a state machine execution
  ##############################################################################
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${WebSocketStepFunctionsIntegration}'

  ##############################################################################
  # Deployment and stage
  ##############################################################################
  WebSocketDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn: DefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  WebSocketStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      AutoDeploy: true

Outputs:
  WebSocketApiEndpoint:
    Description: WebSocket API endpoint (wss://) returned by API Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt WebSocketApi.ApiEndpoint

  WebSocketConnectionUrl:
    Description: Full WebSocket connection URL including the deployed stage.
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'

  DefaultRouteArn:
    Description: ARN of the WebSocket API $default route.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/$default'

  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine invoked by the WebSocket API.
    Value: !Ref WebSocketWorkflow

  StageName:
    Description: Name of the deployed WebSocket API stage.
    Value: !Ref StageName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Scheduled (hourly) AWS Organizations account-closure workflow. Creates an Amazon
  EventBridge rule, an EXPRESS AWS Step Functions state machine that paginates the
  Organizations account list, filters accounts tagged organizations:account-closure
  = REQUESTED, describes each matching account, closes it via CloseAccount when it
  is ACTIVE, tags it ACKNOWLEDGED so it is not reprocessed, and streams all
  execution data to a CloudWatch Logs log group retained for 365 days.

Parameters:
  TagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "organizations:account-closure"
    Description: >-
      Tag key that marks an AWS Organizations account for closure.
  TagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: "REQUESTED"
    Description: >-
      Tag value that marks an AWS Organizations account for closure.
  ScheduleRuleName:
    Type: String
    Default: "organizations-account-closure-hourly"
    Description: >-
      Name of the EventBridge rule that invokes the account closure state machine
      every hour.

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # CloudWatch Logs - 365 day execution history, retained across stack ops
  ##########################################################################
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 365

  ##########################################################################
  # IAM role assumed by EventBridge to start the state machine
  ##########################################################################
  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "organizations-account-closure-events-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: >-
        Allows the hourly EventBridge rule to start the account closure state
        machine execution.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAccountClosureExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartAccountClosureStateMachine
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine
                Condition:
                  ArnEquals:
                    "aws:SourceArn": !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/${ScheduleRuleName}"

  ##########################################################################
  # IAM role assumed by the state machine (least privilege)
  ##########################################################################
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "organizations-account-closure-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: >-
        Least-privilege execution role for the Organizations account closure
        state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OrganizationsAccountClosureAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: OrganizationsListAndDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: OrganizationsCloseAndTagAccount
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                  - organizations:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/*"
              - Sid: WriteStateMachineExecutionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${StateMachineLogGroup}:*"

  ##########################################################################
  # Hourly EventBridge schedule
  ##########################################################################
  ScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ScheduleRuleName
      Description: Invokes the Organizations account closure state machine every hour.
      ScheduleExpression: "rate(1 hour)"
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: OrganizationsAccountClosure
          Arn: !Ref StateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn

  ##########################################################################
  # EXPRESS state machine
  ##########################################################################
  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "organizations-account-closure-${AWS::Region}"
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Level: ALL
      DefinitionString: !Sub |
        {
          "Comment": "Hourly workflow that closes AWS Organizations accounts tagged for closure.",
          "StartAt": "ListAccountsFirstPage",
          "States": {
            "ListAccountsFirstPage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts",
              "ResultPath": "$.page",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                    "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                    "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                    "Organizations.ServiceException"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "MaxAttempts": 5,
                  "BackoffRate": 2
                },
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException",
                    "Organizations.ConstraintViolationException",
                    "Organizations.FinalizingOrganizationException"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                  "MaxAttempts": 3,
                  "BackoffRate": 2
                }
              ],
              "Catch": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "States.ALL"
                  ],
                  "ResultPath": "$.error",
                  "Next": "HandleUnrecoverableError"
                }
              ],
              "Next": "ProcessAccountPage"
            },
            "ProcessAccountPage": {
              "Type": "Map",
              "ItemsPath": "$.page.Accounts",
              "ItemProcessor": {
                "ProcessorConfig": {
                  "Mode": "INLINE"
                },
                "StartAt": "GetAccountTags",
                "States": {
                  "GetAccountTags": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listTagsForResource",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "ResourceId.$": "$.Id"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.tags",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                          "Organizations.ServiceException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "MaxAttempts": 5,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException",
                          "Organizations.ConstraintViolationException",
                          "Organizations.FinalizingOrganizationException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                        "MaxAttempts": 3,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.ALL"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.error",
                        "Next": "AccountError"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "HasTags"
                  },
                  "HasTags": {
                    "Type": "Choice",
                    "Choices": [
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.tags.Tags",
                        "IsPresent": true,
                        "Next": "InitTagScan"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Default": "AccountSkipped"
                  },
                  "InitTagScan": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "index": 0,
                      "count.$": "States.ArrayLength($.tags.Tags)"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.tagScan",
                    "Next": "CheckTagScanComplete"
                  },
                  "CheckTagScanComplete": {
                    "Type": "Choice",
                    "Choices": [
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.tagScan.index",
                        "NumericLessThanPath": "$.tagScan.count",
                        "Next": "GetCurrentTag"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Default": "AccountSkipped"
                  },
                  "GetCurrentTag": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "value.$": "States.ArrayGetItem($.tags.Tags, $.tagScan.index)"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.currentTag",
                    "Next": "EvaluateCurrentTag"
                  },
                  "EvaluateCurrentTag": {
                    "Type": "Choice",
                    "Choices": [
                      {
                        "And": [
                          {
                            "Variable": "$.currentTag.value.Key",
                            "StringEquals": "${TagKey}"
                          },
                          {
                            "Variable": "$.currentTag.value.Value",
                            "StringEquals": "${TagValue}"
                          }
                        ],
                        "Next": "DescribeAccount"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Default": "AdvanceTagIndex"
                  },
                  "AdvanceTagIndex": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "index.$": "States.MathAdd($.tagScan.index, 1)",
                      "count.$": "$.tagScan.count"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.tagScan",
                    "Next": "CheckTagScanComplete"
                  },
                  "DescribeAccount": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.accountDetails",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                          "Organizations.ServiceException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "MaxAttempts": 5,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException",
                          "Organizations.ConstraintViolationException",
                          "Organizations.FinalizingOrganizationException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                        "MaxAttempts": 3,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.ALL"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.error",
                        "Next": "AccountError"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "CheckAccountStatus"
                  },
                  "CheckAccountStatus": {
                    "Type": "Choice",
                    "Choices": [
                      {
                        "Variable": "$.accountDetails.Account.Status",
                        "StringEquals": "ACTIVE",
                        "Next": "CloseAccount"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Default": "AccountSkipped"
                  },
                  "CloseAccount": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "AccountId.$": "$.Id"
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.closeResult",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                          "Organizations.ServiceException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "MaxAttempts": 5,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException",
                          "Organizations.ConstraintViolationException",
                          "Organizations.FinalizingOrganizationException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                        "MaxAttempts": 3,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.ALL"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.error",
                        "Next": "AccountError"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "AcknowledgeClosure"
                  },
                  "AcknowledgeClosure": {
                    "Type": "Task",
                    "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "ResourceId.$": "$.Id",
                      "Tags": [
                        {
                          "Key": "${TagKey}",
                          "Value": "ACKNOWLEDGED"
                        }
                      ]
                    },
                    "ResultPath": "$.acknowledgeResult",
                    "Retry": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                          "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                          "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                          "Organizations.ServiceException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                        "MaxAttempts": 5,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      },
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException",
                          "Organizations.ConstraintViolationException",
                          "Organizations.FinalizingOrganizationException"
                        ],
                        "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                        "MaxAttempts": 3,
                        "BackoffRate": 2
                      }
                    ],
                    "Catch": [
                      {
                        "ErrorEquals": [
                          "States.ALL"
                        ],
                        "ResultPath": "$.error",
                        "Next": "AccountError"
                      }
                    ],
                    "Next": "AccountProcessed"
                  },
                  "AccountProcessed": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "End": true
                  },
                  "AccountSkipped": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "End": true
                  },
                  "AccountError": {
                    "Type": "Pass",
                    "Parameters": {
                      "accountId.$": "$.Id",
                      "accountName.$": "$.Name",
                      "errorName.$": "$.error.Error",
                      "errorCause.$": "$.error.Cause"
                    },
                    "End": true
                  }
                }
              },
              "ResultPath": null,
              "Catch": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "States.ALL"
                  ],
                  "ResultPath": "$.error",
                  "Next": "HandleUnrecoverableError"
                }
              ],
              "Next": "CheckForNextPage"
            },
            "CheckForNextPage": {
              "Type": "Choice",
              "Choices": [
                {
                  "Variable": "$.page.NextToken",
                  "IsPresent": true,
                  "Next": "ListAccountsNextPage"
                }
              ],
              "Default": "WorkflowSucceeded"
            },
            "ListAccountsNextPage": {
              "Type": "Task",
              "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts",
              "Parameters": {
                "NextToken.$": "$.page.NextToken"
              },
              "ResultPath": "$.page",
              "Retry": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Organizations.ThrottlingException",
                    "Organizations.TooManyRequestsException",
                    "Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException",
                    "Organizations.ServiceException"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                  "MaxAttempts": 5,
                  "BackoffRate": 2
                },
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "Organizations.AWSOrganizationsNotInUseException",
                    "Organizations.ConstraintViolationException",
                    "Organizations.FinalizingOrganizationException"
                  ],
                  "IntervalSeconds": 5,
                  "MaxAttempts": 3,
                  "BackoffRate": 2
                }
              ],
              "Catch": [
                {
                  "ErrorEquals": [
                    "States.ALL"
                  ],
                  "ResultPath": "$.error",
                  "Next": "HandleUnrecoverableError"
                }
              ],
              "Next": "ProcessAccountPage"
            },
            "WorkflowSucceeded": {
              "Type": "Succeed"
            },
            "HandleUnrecoverableError": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Parameters": {
                "errorName.$": "$.error.Error",
                "errorCause.$": "$.error.Cause"
              },
              "Next": "FailWorkflow"
            },
            "FailWorkflow": {
              "Type": "Fail",
              "Error": "OrganizationsAccountClosureFailed",
