final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Automated EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds a CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023
  ARM64 (arm64) AMI, pre-configured for AWS Elastic Beanstalk compatibility, distributed in the
  current region with launch permissions shared to an AWS Organization and two deployment
  accounts, and automatically deleted after 180 days (about 6 months) by an Image Builder
  lifecycle policy.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Documented risks / items to verify before deployment (flagged, not worked around):
#
# 1) ParentImage (objective 10): the CIS hardened parent image identifier
#    'cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/x.x.x' is used exactly as
#    requested. Verify in the target region which reference form is valid and accessible:
#      - AWS/Marketplace owned image : arn:<partition>:imagebuilder:<region>:aws:image/<name>/<version>
#      - Subscribed Marketplace image: same ARN form, but published by a vendor account ID
#      - AMI ID / SSM public parameter path (for example /aws/service/...) resolved via a Mapping
#    If the identifier cannot be resolved by the Image Builder service at recipe build time, the
#    recipe/pipeline build fails. Confirm the SemanticVersion as well (the literal 'x.x.x' is a
#    placeholder and normally must be a real version such as 2023.1.1 or 1.0.0).
#
# 2) Vulnerability scanning (objective 17): AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline and
#    AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe expose NO CloudFormation property that turns on Amazon
#    Inspector scanning. Vulnerability scanning of the built AMIs is performed by Amazon
#    Inspector once EC2 scanning is activated for the account/region (Inspector continuously
#    assesses the AMIs the pipeline produces). No property name has been invented here.
#
# 3) Architecture (objective 9): AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe has no 'Architecture' property.
#    The arm64 architecture is enforced by the ARM64 parent image plus the ARM64/Graviton
#    instance type (m6g.large) selected in the infrastructure configuration.
#
# 4) Root volume encryption: the root EBS mapping is intentionally left unencrypted at the
#    default setting (gp3, 50 GB). Encrypting it with the AWS managed 'aws/ebs' key would make the
#    resulting AMI snapshots un-shareable with the dev/prod accounts. If encryption is required,
#    create a customer managed KMS key in this template and grant the target accounts access to it.
#
# 5) Lifecycle policy execution schedule: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy exposes no
#    CloudFormation property for the policy's execution schedule (only Name, Description, Status,
#    ResourceType, ExecutionRole, ResourceSelection, PolicyDetails and Tags are supported). The
#    schedule cannot be expressed here and no differently named property has been invented; the
#    lifecycle policy still deletes AMIs and their snapshots once they reach 180 days.
#
# 6) Build network egress design (security constraint, no open Internet egress):
#    The build subnet is private (no auto-assigned public IPs) and the build security group does
#    NOT allow egress to 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. All package, agent and control-plane traffic is routed
#    through VPC endpoints (S3 gateway endpoint plus interface endpoints for ssm, ssmmessages,
#    ec2messages, ec2, kms, sts and CloudWatch Logs). Trade-off: if a future build step needs an
#    arbitrary third-party Internet repository, the endpoint-only design will not reach it and a
#    NAT-based path would be required - but a NAT path must NOT be implemented by reintroducing a
#    0.0.0.0/0 security-group rule; that exposure has to be solved at the route/endpoint layer.
#
# 7) Lifecycle execution role permissions are defined as an INLINE policy inside this template
#    rather than by attaching the AWS-managed 'EC2ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionPolicy'. This keeps
#    the template self-contained (greenfield: no dependency on an externally published managed
#    policy) and deployable in environments where that managed policy is not available. Do NOT
#    re-add the managed-policy ARN to this role; it will reintroduce an unresolvable dependency.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: cis-eb-al2023-arm64
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 3-32 characters of lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, starting with a letter or number.
    Description: Name prefix applied to every resource created by this template.

  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: 'o-xxxxxxxxxx'
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must match the AWS Organizations ID format, 'o-' followed by 10 lowercase alphanumeric characters.
    Description: AWS Organizations ID used to grant organization-wide launch permissions on the distributed AMI.

  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12 digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Destination AWS account ID for the development environment (dummy placeholder value by default).

  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12 digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Destination AWS account ID for the production environment (dummy placeholder value by default).

Resources:

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking (greenfield account - everything the build needs is created here)
  # Private build subnet: no auto-assigned public IPs, no open 0.0.0.0/0 egress. Outbound
  # package / agent / control-plane traffic flows through the VPC endpoints defined below.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  BuildVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-vpc'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-build
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-private-subnet'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-build
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BuildRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-private-rt'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-build
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  BuildSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref BuildRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet

  BuildSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName} EC2 Image Builder build instance security group (VPC-internal traffic only)'
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS to VPC interface endpoints (ssm, ssmmessages, ec2messages, logs, ec2, kms, sts)
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: DNS (TCP) to the VPC resolver
        - IpProtocol: udp
          FromPort: 53
          ToPort: 53
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: DNS (UDP) to the VPC resolver
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-imagebuilder-build-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-build
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Security group attached to the interface VPC endpoints. Ingress is limited to HTTPS from the
  # VPC CIDR only; egress is explicitly empty so no default 0.0.0.0/0 rule exists.
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub '${ProjectName} VPC interface endpoint security group (HTTPS from VPC only)'
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS from resources inside the build VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress: []
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpce-sg'
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-build
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # Gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 (AL2023 repository objects and Image Builder build artifacts).
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref BuildRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcAccessToS3
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::amazonlinux.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::amazonlinux.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::amazonlinux-2-repos-${AWS::Region}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::amazonlinux-2-repos-${AWS::Region}/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::ec2imagebuilder*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::ec2imagebuilder*/*'

  SsmInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  SsmMessagesInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  Ec2MessagesInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  Ec2InterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  KmsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  StsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  LogsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref BuildVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM: build instance role / instance profile (data plane)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ib-instance-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: EC2 Image Builder build instance role (data plane identity)
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-build
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ib-instance-profile-${AWS::Region}'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM: Image Builder service role (control plane)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ib-service-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: EC2 Image Builder service role used to launch and manage build instances
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ib-service-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassBuildInstanceRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ec2.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: ManageBuildInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
                  - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ImageBuilderBuildBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::ec2imagebuilder*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::ec2imagebuilder*/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-build
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder: custom Elastic Beanstalk compatibility component (ARM64 compatible)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ElasticBeanstalkComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-eb-al2023-arm64-component'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: >-
        Pre-configures the CIS hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 image for AWS Elastic Beanstalk
        compatibility (platform hook layout, prerequisite packages, required agents).
      ChangeDescription: Initial version
      Platform: Linux
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkCompatibility
        description: Prepares the Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 image for AWS Elastic Beanstalk
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallElasticBeanstalkPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf -y install unzip tar gzip git shadow-utils
                    - dnf -y clean all
              - name: ConfigureElasticBeanstalkLayout
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /etc/elasticbeanstalk
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /opt/elasticbeanstalk
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/pre
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/post
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/configdeploy/pre
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/configdeploy/post
                    - install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /var/log/elasticbeanstalk
              - name: EnableRequiredAgents
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
                    - systemctl enable chronyd
                    - systemctl is-enabled amazon-ssm-agent
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateElasticBeanstalkCompatibility
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - test -d /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/appdeploy/pre
                    - test -d /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks/configdeploy/pre
                    - test -d /etc/elasticbeanstalk
                    - systemctl is-enabled amazon-ssm-agent
                    - echo "Elastic Beanstalk compatibility validation passed"
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: shared-build
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder: image recipe (CIS hardened AL2023 ARM64 parent + EB component, 50 GB gp3 root)
  # REMINDER (objective 10): verify the ParentImage reference below before deploying - see the
  # risk notes at the top of this template.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ElasticBeanstalkImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-recipe-${AWS::Region}'
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: >-
        CIS Level 1 hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 image with Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
        pre-configuration and a 50 GB gp3 root volume.
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: shared-build
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder: distribution configuration (current region, org + dev/prod launch permissions)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-distribution-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Distributes the hardened Elastic Beanstalk AMI in the current region and shares launch permissions.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-al2023-cis-eb-arm64-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub '${ProjectName} CIS Level 1 hardened AL2023 ARM64 image for Elastic Beanstalk'
            AmiTags:
              Project: !Ref ProjectName
              ManagedBy: CloudFormation
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: shared-build
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder: infrastructure configuration (ARM64 instance, private subnet, build SG)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-infrastructure-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Build infrastructure for the hardened AL2023 ARM64 Elastic Beanstalk AMI.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - m6g.large
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref BuildSecurityGroup
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: shared-build
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder: pipeline (daily schedule, image tests enabled)
  # Vulnerability scanning is provided by Amazon Inspector at the account/region level - there is
  # no CloudFormation property on this resource for it (see risk note 2).
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ImageBuilderPipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-pipeline-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Daily build of the CIS Level 1 hardened AL2023 ARM64 Elastic Beanstalk AMI.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ElasticBeanstalkImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 0 * * ? *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: shared-build
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder: lifecycle execution role
  # Permissions are defined inline (see risk note 7) instead of attaching the AWS-managed
  # EC2ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionPolicy, so the template stays self-contained and deployable.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ib-lifecycle-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Execution role used by the EC2 Image Builder lifecycle policy to delete old AMIs and snapshots.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ib-lifecycle-execution-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DeleteAmiAndSnapshots
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadLifecyclePolicyAndRecipe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetLifecyclePolicy
                  - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
                  - imagebuilder:ListImageRecipes
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:GetImagePipeline
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                  - imagebuilder:ListComponents
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EvaluateResourceSelectionFilters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - tag:GetResources
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: shared-build
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder: lifecycle policy (delete AMIs and snapshots older than 180 days)
  # Note: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy exposes no CloudFormation property for the policy's
  # execution schedule, so it is not expressed here and no property name has been invented.
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lifecycle-policy-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Deletes AMIs and their snapshots built from this recipe once they are 180 days old.
      Status: ENABLED
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-recipe-${AWS::Region}'
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
            IncludeResources:
              Amis: true
              Snapshots: true
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: shared-build
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 Image Builder image pipeline.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderPipeline.Arn

  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe that builds the hardened Elastic Beanstalk AMI.
    Value: !GetAtt ElasticBeanstalkImageRecipe.Arn

  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the distribution configuration (current region, org and account launch permissions).
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderDistributionConfiguration.Arn

  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the infrastructure configuration used for the builds.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInfrastructureConfiguration.Arn

  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the lifecycle policy that deletes AMIs older than 180 days.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderLifecyclePolicy.Arn

  BuildSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group used by the Image Builder build instances (VPC-internal egress only).
    Value: !Ref BuildSecurityGroup

  BuildSubnetId:
    Description: Private subnet used for the Image Builder build instances.
    Value: !Ref BuildSubnet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless Maths MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for testing. Creates a regional
  Amazon API Gateway REST API with a Cognito user pool protected POST /mcp endpoint, a
  public GET / health check endpoint, CORS preflight support through an OPTIONS method,
  and a Python 3.12 AWS Lambda placeholder function. All dependencies are created inside
  this template.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment stage (environment) name used for the API Gateway stage.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool used to authenticate MCP API callers.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool app client used for password based authentication.

Resources:

  MathsMcpUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: true
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false

  MathsMcpUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref MathsMcpUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  MathsMcpLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-lambda-role
      Description: Execution role for the serverless Maths MCP Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  MathsMcpFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp
      Description: Placeholder handler for the serverless Maths MCP server.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt MathsMcpLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type,Authorization",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "OPTIONS,POST,GET",
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps(
                      {
                          "status": "ok",
                          "service": "maths-mcp",
                          "message": "Placeholder handler - implementation to be added",
                      }
                  ),
              }

  MathsMcpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-api
      Description: Regional REST API fronting the serverless Maths MCP Lambda function.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  MathsMcpAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-cognito-authorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt MathsMcpUserPool.Arn

  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MathsMcpApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  RootHealthMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt MathsMcpApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations

  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref MathsMcpAuthorizer
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${MathsMcpFunction.Arn}/invocations

  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      ApiKeyRequired: false
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Amz-Date,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST,GET'"
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true

  MathsMcpInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MathsMcpFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MathsMcpApi}/*/*/*

  MathsMcpDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - RootHealthMethod
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      Description: !Sub API deployment for the serverless Maths MCP server (${AWS::StackName}).

  MathsMcpStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
      RestApiId: !Ref MathsMcpApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref MathsMcpDeployment
      Description: !Sub Maths MCP API stage ${DeploymentStage}.

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Base invoke URL of the regional Maths MCP REST API for the deployment stage.
    Value: !Sub https://${MathsMcpApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool used to authenticate MCP API callers.
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpUserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito app client used for password based authentication.
    Value: !Ref MathsMcpUserPoolClient

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Amazon Verified Permissions policy store for the Bookstore application. Defines a
  strictly validated Cedar schema for the Bookstore namespace (Role, User and Book
  entities; View and ViewWithPremiumOffers actions requiring a region request context),
  a set of static Cedar policies implementing admin, publisher, customer and
  location-based access control, and an SSM parameter publishing the policy store ID
  for downstream stacks. Fully self-contained (greenfield); no external resources.

Resources:
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Verified Permissions policy store with the Bookstore Cedar schema (STRICT validation)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BookstorePolicyStore:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::PolicyStore
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ValidationSettings:
        Mode: STRICT
      Schema:
        CedarJson: |
          {
            "Bookstore": {
              "entityTypes": {
                "Role": {
                  "memberOfTypes": [
                    "Role"
                  ]
                },
                "User": {
                  "memberOfTypes": [
                    "Role"
                  ],
                  "shape": {
                    "type": "Record",
                    "attributes": {
                      "yearsAsMember": {
                        "type": "Long"
                      }
                    }
                  }
                },
                "Book": {
                  "shape": {
                    "type": "Record",
                    "attributes": {
                      "owner": {
                        "type": "Entity",
                        "name": "User"
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              },
              "actions": {
                "View": {
                  "appliesTo": {
                    "principalTypes": [
                      "User"
                    ],
                    "resourceTypes": [
                      "Book"
                    ],
                    "context": {
                      "type": "Record",
                      "attributes": {
                        "region": {
                          "type": "String"
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                },
                "ViewWithPremiumOffers": {
                  "appliesTo": {
                    "principalTypes": [
                      "User"
                    ],
                    "resourceTypes": [
                      "Book"
                    ],
                    "context": {
                      "type": "Record",
                      "attributes": {
                        "region": {
                          "type": "String"
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Static Cedar policy: Admin role may view any book
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminViewAnyBookPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: "Admin role can view any book"
          Statement: |
            permit(
              principal in Bookstore::Role::"Admin",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
              resource
            );

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Static Cedar policy: explicit forbid for one named administrator (overrides permit)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DenySpecificAdminViewPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: "Explicitly deny the specific AdminUser from viewing any book"
          Statement: |
            forbid(
              principal == Bookstore::User::"AdminUser",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
              resource
            );

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Static Cedar policy: Publisher may view only the books they own
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublisherViewOwnedBooksPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: "Publisher role can view only the books it owns"
          Statement: |
            permit(
              principal in Bookstore::Role::"Publisher",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
              resource
            )
            when {
              resource.owner == principal
            };

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Static Cedar policy: one named user may view one named book
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SpecificUserSpecificBookViewPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: "SpecificUser can view the SpecificBook"
          Statement: |
            permit(
              principal == Bookstore::User::"SpecificUser",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"View",
              resource == Bookstore::Book::"SpecificBook"
            );

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Static Cedar policy: Customer with 2+ years of membership sees premium offers
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CustomerPremiumOffersTwoYearsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: "Customer role can view premium offers after two years of membership"
          Statement: |
            permit(
              principal in Bookstore::Role::"Customer",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers",
              resource
            )
            when {
              principal.yearsAsMember >= 2
            };

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Static Cedar policy: forbid premium offers for customers with < 2 years
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DenyCustomerPremiumOffersUnderTwoYearsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: "Deny premium offers for customers with less than two years of membership"
          Statement: |
            forbid(
              principal in Bookstore::Role::"Customer",
              action == Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers",
              resource
            )
            when {
              principal.yearsAsMember < 2
            };

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Static Cedar policy: deny all access from outside the United States
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DenyOutsideUnitedStatesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::VerifiedPermissions::Policy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      PolicyStoreId: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore
      Definition:
        Static:
          Description: "Deny non-US regions"
          Statement: |
            forbid(
              principal,
              action in [
                Bookstore::Action::"View",
                Bookstore::Action::"ViewWithPremiumOffers"
              ],
              resource
            )
            when {
              context.region != "United States"
            };

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM parameter publishing the policy store ID for downstream stacks
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BookstorePolicyStoreIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /bookstore/verified-permissions/policy-store-id
      Type: String
      Description: "Policy store ID of the Bookstore Amazon Verified Permissions policy store"
      Value: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore

Outputs:
  BookstorePolicyStoreId:
    Description: Identifier of the Amazon Verified Permissions policy store for the Bookstore application
    Value: !Ref BookstorePolicyStore

  BookstorePolicyStoreArn:
    Description: ARN of the Amazon Verified Permissions policy store for the Bookstore application
    Value: !GetAtt BookstorePolicyStore.Arn

  BookstorePolicyStoreIdParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter that publishes the Bookstore policy store ID
    Value: !Ref BookstorePolicyStoreIdParameter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  RAPIDS AI development environment: a SageMaker notebook instance (rapidsai)
  with an execution IAM role, a lifecycle configuration that installs the
  RAPIDS conda environment and registers a Jupyter kernel on create/start,
  and the default RAPIDS notebooks code repository.

Resources:

  RapidsNotebookRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess

  RapidsLifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName: rapidsai-lifecycle-config
      OnCreate:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e
            sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'EOP'
            set -e
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
            if ! conda env list | grep -qE '^rapids[[:space:]]'; then
              conda create -y -n rapids -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia \
                python=3.10 cudatoolkit=11.8 rapids=24.02
            fi
            conda activate rapids
            python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name "RAPIDS"
            EOP
      OnStart:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            #!/bin/bash
            set -e
            sudo -u ec2-user -i <<'EOP'
            set -e
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
            if ! conda env list | grep -qE '^rapids[[:space:]]'; then
              conda create -y -n rapids -c rapidsai -c conda-forge -c nvidia \
                python=3.10 cudatoolkit=11.8 rapids=24.02
            fi
            conda activate rapids
            python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name "RAPIDS"
            EOP

  RapidsNotebookInstance:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: rapidsai
      InstanceType: ml.t3.medium
      VolumeSizeInGB: 50
      RootAccess: Enabled
      DirectInternetAccess: Enabled
      DefaultCodeRepository: https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks
      RoleArn: !GetAtt RapidsNotebookRole.Arn
      LifecycleConfigName: !GetAtt RapidsLifecycleConfig.NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfigName

Outputs:

  NotebookInstanceName:
    Description: Name of the RAPIDS AI SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !Ref RapidsNotebookInstance

  NotebookInstanceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the RAPIDS AI notebook instance
    Value: !GetAtt RapidsNotebookRole.Arn

  LifecycleConfigName:
    Description: Name of the RAPIDS AI notebook instance lifecycle configuration
    Value: !Ref RapidsLifecycleConfig
deploy_logs: ["Creating stack 'iac-god-eval-b200dc69' on localstack", 'iac-god-eval-b200dc69: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'RapidsLifecycleConfig: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A', 'RapidsLifecycleConfig: CREATE_COMPLETE - Resource type AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig is not supported but was deployed as a fallback', 'RapidsNotebookRole: CREATE_IN_PROGRESS - N/A']
deploy_completed_resources: RapidsLifecycleConfig

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice that registers itself with a private
  AWS Cloud Map service discovery namespace so other services in the same
  environment can resolve it by DNS name. The stack creates its own VPC with a
  public subnet and two private subnets across separate Availability Zones, an
  internet gateway, a NAT gateway, an ECS cluster and security group, an ECS
  task definition and service, CloudWatch logging, VPC endpoints for private
  AWS service access, and Application Auto Scaling between 2 and 10 tasks
  driven by CPU utilization CloudWatch alarms.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Name of the environment (used for naming and tagging resources).

  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: microservice
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Name of the microservice (used for naming and tagging resources).

  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    MinLength: 1
    Description: Container image to run in the ECS task (for example nginx:latest).

  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: Port the container listens on and the port registered in Cloud Map.

  TaskCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    Description: CPU units for the Fargate task definition (256 = 0.25 vCPU).

  TaskMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Memory (MiB) for the Fargate task definition.

  DesiredTaskCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Desired number of ECS tasks to run.

  CustomTaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of an existing IAM role the containers can assume for
      accessing other AWS resources. Leave empty to skip the additional policy
      attachment.

Conditions:
  HasCustomTaskRole: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn
      - ''

Resources:

  ##############################################################################
  # Networking
  ##############################################################################
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-nat'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Sub '${AWS::Region}a'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-0'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Sub '${AWS::Region}b'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Sub '${AWS::Region}c'
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
        - Key: Type
          Value: Private

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ##############################################################################
  # Security groups
  ##############################################################################
  TaskSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'ECS tasks for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Application port from within the VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow all traffic to destinations within the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-tasks-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskSecurityGroupSelfIngressTcp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
      Description: Container to container communication

  TaskSecurityGroupSelfIngressAll:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: -1
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
      Description: All traffic between tasks in this security group

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub 'VPC interface endpoints for ${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
          Description: HTTPS from the ECS tasks
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: -1
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: Allow all traffic to destinations within the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-endpoints-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ##############################################################################
  # VPC endpoints for private AWS service access
  ##############################################################################
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-s3-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  LogsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-logs-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  EcrApiInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-ecr-api-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  EcrDkrInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-ecr-dkr-endpoint'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ##############################################################################
  # ECS cluster, logging and IAM
  ##############################################################################
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-execution-role'
      Description: ECS task execution role for pulling images and writing logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  TaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-role'
      Description: Application permissions role assumed by the containers.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-task-logs'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  CustomTaskRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: HasCustomTaskRole
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-custom-role-logs'
      Roles:
        - !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn

  AutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-ecs-autoscaling-role'
      Description: Role used by Application Auto Scaling to scale the ECS service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceAutoscaleRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ##############################################################################
  # Cloud Map private service discovery
  ##############################################################################
  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.local'
      Description: !Sub 'Private DNS namespace for the ${EnvironmentName} environment'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  DiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub 'Service discovery entry for ${ServiceName}'
      NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIWEIGHT
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ##############################################################################
  # ECS task definition and service
  ##############################################################################
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      PlatformVersion: LATEST
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredTaskCount
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !GetAtt TaskSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref ServiceName

  ##############################################################################
  # Application Auto Scaling
  ##############################################################################
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${ECSCluster}/${ECSService.Name}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-up'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 20
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 40
            ScalingAdjustment: 4

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-down'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ScaleUpAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Scale out the ECS service when average CPU utilization is greater than
        or equal to 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy

  ScaleDownAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cpu-low'
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Scale in the ECS service when average CPU utilization is less than or
        equal to 20 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 2
      DatapointsToAlarm: 2
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy

Outputs:
  ClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster.
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster

  ServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service.
    Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name

  ServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS service.
    Value: !Ref ECSService

  TaskDefinitionArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task definition.
    Value: !Ref TaskDefinition

  ServiceDiscoveryNamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the private Cloud Map namespace.
    Value: !GetAtt PrivateDnsNamespace.Id

  ServiceDiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service registered by the ECS tasks.
    Value: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn

  ServiceDiscoveryDnsName:
    Description: Private DNS name other services use to discover this service.
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.local'

  TaskSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group attached to the ECS tasks.
    Value: !GetAtt TaskSecurityGroup.GroupId

  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch log group receiving container logs.
    Value: !Ref LogGroup
