final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS-to-OCI hybrid interconnect network backbone. It creates a
  VPC with DNS support, an internet gateway, a private subnet in the first
  available Availability Zone, a route table with a default route via the IGW, a
  transit gateway with a VPC attachment plus a dedicated transit gateway route
  table and OCI route, a least-privilege security group (HTTPS inbound from the
  internal CIDR range, HTTPS outbound only to the OCI backbone CIDR), an optional
  static-routing VPN connection to an OCI primary region, and VPC flow logs
  encrypted with a customer-managed rotating KMS key and delivered to a
  CloudWatch log group with 30-day retention.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - SubnetCidr
          - OnPremInternalCidr
          - OciBackboneCidr
      - Label:
          default: OCI hybrid interconnect
        Parameters:
          - CreateVpn
          - OciVpnPublicIp
          - OciBgpAsn
          - OciSecondaryCidr
      - Label:
          default: Tagging
        Parameters:
          - Environment
          - ProjectName

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: demo
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-32 characters, alphanumeric, hyphen or underscore.
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging.

  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-oci-hybrid
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-32 characters, alphanumeric, hyphen or underscore.
    Description: Project name used for resource tagging.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3})/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
    Description: CIDR block assigned to the hybrid interconnect VPC.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3})/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block contained in VpcCidr.
    Description: CIDR block assigned to the private subnet.

  OnPremInternalCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3})/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
    Description: Internal on-premises CIDR range allowed to reach the workload over HTTPS.

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.100.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3})/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
    Description: Primary OCI backbone CIDR range used for egress and OCI routing.

  OciSecondaryCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.101.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3})/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block.
    Description: Additional OCI prefix advertised over the static VPN connection.

  CreateVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create the customer gateway, VPN gateway and static VPN connection to OCI.

  OciVpnPublicIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.1
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3})$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a dotted-quad IPv4 address matching the parameter AllowedPattern.
    Description: >-
      Public IP address of the OCI VPN head end. The default 203.0.113.1 is an
      RFC 5737 documentation-range placeholder only and MUST be overridden with
      the real OCI VPN head-end address whenever CreateVpn is set to 'true'. It
      is never used while CreateVpn is 'false' because the customer gateway is
      conditionally created.

  OciBgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 65000
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 4294967294
    Description: BGP autonomous system number configured on the OCI customer gateway.

Conditions:
  CreateVpn: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateVpn
    - 'true'

Resources:
  HybridVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HybridInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HybridIgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HybridVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref HybridInternetGateway

  HybridPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HybridVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs
          Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-private-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HybridPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HybridVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HybridPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref HybridPrivateRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref HybridPrivateSubnet

  HybridDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: HybridIgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref HybridPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref HybridInternetGateway

  HybridTgw:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: AWS-to-OCI hybrid interconnect transit gateway
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HybridTgwVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref HybridTgw
      VpcId: !Ref HybridVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref HybridPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-tgw-vpc-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HybridTgwRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref HybridTgw
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-tgw-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HybridTgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref HybridTgwVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref HybridTgwRouteTable

  HybridTgwRouteTablePropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref HybridTgwVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref HybridTgwRouteTable

  HybridTgwOciRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn:
      - HybridTgwRouteTableAssociation
      - HybridTgwRouteTablePropagation
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref HybridTgwRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref HybridTgwVpcAttachment
      Blackhole: false

  HybridAppSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: HTTPS from the internal CIDR range and HTTPS to the OCI backbone only
      VpcId: !Ref HybridVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OnPremInternalCidr
          Description: HTTPS from the internal on-premises range
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: HTTPS to the OCI backbone range only
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-app-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  FlowLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK used to encrypt VPC flow logs for the AWS-to-OCI hybrid backbone
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountRootAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-flow-logs-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  FlowLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  FlowLogsDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Least-privilege role that lets VPC flow logs write to the encrypted log group
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowVpcFlowLogsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogEventsToOwnLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HybridVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn:
      - FlowLogsDeliveryRole
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref HybridVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsDeliveryRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  OciCustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      IpAddress: !Ref OciVpnPublicIp
      BgpAsn: !Ref OciBgpAsn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-oci-customer-gateway'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  HybridVpnGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNGateway
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-vpn-gateway'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  DynamoDB global table for testing with on-demand (PAY_PER_REQUEST) billing,
  point-in-time recovery, server-side encryption, streams, and a replica in a
  second region supplied by the ReplicaRegion parameter, plus CloudWatch alarms
  for table health, capacity, latency and replication. Replication alarms
  (PendingReplicationCount, ReplicationLatency) depend on the global-table
  replica and would not be emitted by a single-region table. Alarms notify an
  SNS topic that is encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key created in this
  template; subscribe endpoints manually after deployment because unattended
  deployment has no email parameter. The ReplicaRegion parameter must differ
  from the stack's deployment region (enforced by a template Rule).

Rules:
  ReplicaRegionMustDifferFromDeploymentRegion:
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ReplicaRegion, !Ref 'AWS::Region']]
        AssertDescription: >
          ReplicaRegion must be different from the stack deployment region;
          a global table cannot declare its own region as an additional replica.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: dynamodb-test
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 40
    Description: Application name used in table and alarm names.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Environment name used in table and alarm names.
  ReplicaRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedValues:
      - us-east-1
      - us-east-2
      - us-west-1
      - us-west-2
      - eu-west-1
      - eu-central-1
      - ap-southeast-1
      - ap-southeast-2
      - ap-northeast-1
    Description: >
      Region for the DynamoDB global-table replica. Must differ from the stack's
      deployment region.

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::GlobalTable
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment}-dynamodb-table'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      # SSEEnabled true uses an AWS managed KMS key by default; no customer KMS ARN is needed.
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      # NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES is mandatory for global tables.
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      # PITR and Tags are replica-level settings on a global table.
      Replicas:
        - Region: !Ref ReplicaRegion
          PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
            PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
          Tags:
            - Key: Application
              Value: !Ref AppName
            - Key: Environment
              Value: !Ref Environment

  DynamoDbAlarmTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the DynamoDB alarm SNS topic
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: dynamodb-alarm-topic-key-policy
        Statement:
          # Allow the account root full control and IAM policy delegation.
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          # Allow CloudWatch to publish encrypted alarm notifications.
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToGenerateDataKeyAndDecrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          # Allow SNS to encrypt on publish and decrypt for subscribers.
          - Sid: AllowSnsToEncryptAndDecrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'

  DynamoDbAlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: DynamoDB Alarm Topic
      TopicName: !Sub '${AppName}-${Environment}-dynamodb-alarms'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DynamoDbAlarmTopicKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-WriteThrottleEvents'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Write throttle events >= 1 for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-ThrottledRequests'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Throttled requests >= 1 for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ConditionalCheckFailedRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-ConditionalCheckFailedRequests'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Conditional check failed requests >= 1 for table ${DynamoDBTable}; application-level optimistic-locking failure signal, not a capacity problem'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ConditionalCheckFailedRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-UserErrors'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'User errors >= 1 for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-SystemErrors'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'System errors >= 1 for table ${DynamoDBTable}; service-side 5xx indicator, higher severity than UserErrors'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  TransactionConflictAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-TransactionConflict'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Transaction conflicts >= 1 for table ${DynamoDBTable}; metric only reports for TransactWriteItems, expected to stay at zero for this plain table'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: TransactionConflict
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  OnlineIndexThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-OnlineIndexThrottleEvents'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Online index throttle events >= 10 for table ${DynamoDBTable}; only fires for global secondary indexes, and this table has none'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: OnlineIndexThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  SuccessfulRequestLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-SuccessfulRequestLatency'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Average successful request latency >= 100 ms for table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SuccessfulRequestLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      Unit: Milliseconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AccountProvisionedReadCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-AccountProvisionedReadCapacityUtilization'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Account-level provisioned read capacity utilization >= 85 percent; provisioned-capacity metric is not meaningful for on-demand (PAY_PER_REQUEST) table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: AccountProvisionedReadCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AccountProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-AccountProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilization'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Account-level provisioned write capacity utilization >= 85 percent; provisioned-capacity metric is not meaningful for on-demand (PAY_PER_REQUEST) table ${DynamoDBTable}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: AccountProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  TableReadCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-ReadCapacityUtilization'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Table-level read capacity utilization >= 85 percent for table ${DynamoDBTable} using metric math consumed/provisioned*100; may be INSUFFICIENT_DATA for on-demand tables'
      Metrics:
        - Id: consumedRead
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ConsumedReadCapacityUnits
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: provisionedRead
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ProvisionedReadCapacityUnits
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: readUtilization
          Expression: "100 * consumedRead / provisionedRead"
          Label: "ReadCapacityUtilization"
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 85
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  TableWriteCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-WriteCapacityUtilization'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Table-level write capacity utilization >= 85 percent for table ${DynamoDBTable} using metric math consumed/provisioned*100; may be INSUFFICIENT_DATA for on-demand tables'
      Metrics:
        - Id: consumedWrite
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ConsumedWriteCapacityUnits
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: provisionedWrite
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: ProvisionedWriteCapacityUnits
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
            Period: 60
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: writeUtilization
          Expression: "100 * consumedWrite / provisionedWrite"
          Label: "WriteCapacityUtilization"
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 85
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PendingReplicationCountAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-PendingReplicationCount'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Pending replication count >= 100 for table ${DynamoDBTable} to region ${ReplicaRegion}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: PendingReplicationCount
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
        - Name: ReceivingRegion
          Value: !Ref ReplicaRegion
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ReplicationLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub
        - '${TableName}-ReplicationLatency'
        - TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Replication latency >= 10 ms for table ${DynamoDBTable} to region ${ReplicaRegion}'
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReplicationLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
        - Name: ReceivingRegion
          Value: !Ref ReplicaRegion
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 10
      Unit: Milliseconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref DynamoDbAlarmTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref AppName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:

    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: PiBot Cognito authentication stacks - main web application and IoT trusted user provisioning (self-contained, greenfield)

Resources:

 ############################################################################
 # Main PiBot web application
 ############################################################################

  PiBotWebUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pibot-web-user-pool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: PiBot
        Component: WebApp

  PiBotWebUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pibot-web-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref PiBotWebUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  PiBotWebIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pibot-web-identity-pool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PiBotWebUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt PiBotWebUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot
        - Key: Component
          Value: WebApp

  PiBotWebAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pibot-web-auth-role"
      Description: IAM role assumed by authenticated users of the main PiBot web application
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PiBotWebIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotWebAuthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: IotCommonOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: KinesisVideoStreaming
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: RekognitionLabelDetection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CognitoIdentityAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CognitoUserAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:GetUser
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: MobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: "*"

  PiBotWebUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pibot-web-unauth-role"
      Description: IAM role assumed by unauthenticated (guest) users of the main PiBot web application
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PiBotWebIdentityPool
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotWebUnauthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: IotCommonOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: KinesisVideoStreaming
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - kinesisvideo:GetMedia
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: RekognitionLabelDetection
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: MobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: "*"

  PiBotWebIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PiBotWebIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt PiBotWebAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt PiBotWebUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

 ############################################################################
 # IoT trusted user provisioning
 ############################################################################

  PiBotProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pibot-provisioning-user-pool"
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: "OFF"
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: PiBot
        Component: Provisioning

  PiBotProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pibot-provisioning-client"
      UserPoolId: !Ref PiBotProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  PiBotProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pibot-provisioning-identity-pool"
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: false
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PiBotProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !GetAtt PiBotProvisioningUserPool.ProviderName
          ServerSideTokenCheck: true
      IdentityPoolTags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PiBot
        - Key: Component
          Value: Provisioning

  PiBotProvisioningAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-pibot-provisioning-auth-role"
      Description: IAM role assumed by authenticated IoT trusted user provisioning users
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Ref PiBotProvisioningIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotProvisioningAuthenticatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: IotTrustedUserProvisioning
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:DescribeProvisioningTemplate
                  - iot:CreateProvisioningClaim
                  - iot:CreateKeysAndCertificate
                  - iot:RegisterThing
                  - iot:StartNextPendingJobExecution
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CognitoIdentityAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:GetId
                  - cognito-identity:GetCredentialsForIdentity
                Resource: "*"

  PiBotProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PiBotProvisioningIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt PiBotProvisioningAuthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:

  WebIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity pool ID for the main PiBot web application
    Value: !Ref PiBotWebIdentityPool

  WebUserPoolId:
    Description: User pool ID for the main PiBot web application
    Value: !Ref PiBotWebUserPool

  WebUserPoolClientId:
    Description: User pool client ID for the main PiBot web application
    Value: !Ref PiBotWebUserPoolClient

  WebAuthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the authenticated IAM role for the main PiBot web application
    Value: !GetAtt PiBotWebAuthenticatedRole.Arn

  WebUnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the unauthenticated IAM role for the main PiBot web application
    Value: !GetAtt PiBotWebUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity pool ID for the PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning setup
    Value: !Ref PiBotProvisioningIdentityPool

  ProvisioningUserPoolId:
    Description: User pool ID for the PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning setup
    Value: !Ref PiBotProvisioningUserPool

  ProvisioningUserPoolClientId:
    Description: User pool client ID for the PiBot IoT trusted user provisioning setup
    Value: !Ref PiBotProvisioningUserPoolClient

  ProvisioningAuthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the authenticated IAM role for the PiBot provisioning setup
    Value: !GetAtt PiBotProvisioningAuthenticatedRole.Arn

# =============================================================================
# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration.
#
# This template is SELF-CONTAINED (greenfield): it provisions every resource it
# depends on. It creates:
#   - A Cognito user pool + secretless public app client (no secret, NO OAuth
#     flow enabled) used solely to supply the JWT issuer/discovery URL and the
#     client_id audience for the gateway authorizer. An authorization-code flow
#     with real callback URLs can be added later if interactive user login is
#     needed.
#   - A placeholder Lambda backend (PredictorFunction) plus its execution role.
#     The placeholder CODE MUST BE REPLACED with the real predictor image/handler.
#   - The AgentCore gateway execution role, the gateway (CUSTOM_JWT authorizer),
#     and the gateway target binding the gateway to the Lambda over MCP.
#   - One SSM parameter that stores the gateway role ARN for downstream readers.
#
# It creates no VPCs, subnets, security groups, or other networking resources —
# AgentCore is fully managed.
#
# PLACEHOLDER-LAMBDA NOTE: PredictorFunction is a deploy-time placeholder using
# an inline ZipFile handler. Replace it with the real protein-variant predictor
# code/container image before production use. If the real backend is ever moved
# behind external infrastructure, re-point the GatewayRole policy Resource and
# the GatewayTarget LambdaArn accordingly.
#
# MCP TOOL CONTRACT (inline target schema below):
#   invoke_endpoint(sequence: string) -> { job_id: string }
#   get_results(job_id: string) -> { status: string, results: object }
#
# NOTE: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget has no Tags property, so cost
# attribution for the target rolls up through the parent Gateway.
# =============================================================================
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: |
  Provisions a self-contained Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for MCP integration: a Cognito user
  pool and secretless public app client for the CUSTOM_JWT authorizer, a placeholder Lambda backend
  plus its execution role, the gateway execution role, the gateway, the gateway target, and one SSM
  parameter storing the gateway role ARN for downstream consumers. No VPCs, subnets, security
  groups, or other networking resources are created.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,30}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit, contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, and be 3-32 characters long.
    Description: Project name used to derive deterministic SSM parameter paths and resource names.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: MCP gateway for protein variant effect prediction
    MinLength: 1
    Description: Description applied to the AgentCore Gateway and GatewayTarget.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional gateway name. If blank, the gateway name is auto-generated as <ProjectName>-gateway.

Conditions:
  HasGatewayName: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref GatewayName
      - ''

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Placeholder Lambda backend + execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for the ${ProjectName} placeholder predictor Lambda.'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  PredictorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-predictor'
      Description: Placeholder protein variant effect prediction backend (replace with real predictor code/image).
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 512
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import uuid

          def handler(event, context):
              # Placeholder implementation for the MCP tool contract:
              #   invoke_endpoint(sequence) -> {"job_id": ...}
              #   get_results(job_id)      -> {"status": ..., "results": ...}
              # Replace with the real protein-variant effect prediction logic.
              action = event.get("action") or event.get("tool")
              if action == "invoke_endpoint":
                  return {"job_id": str(uuid.uuid4())}
              if action == "get_results":
                  return {"status": "COMPLETED", "results": {}}
              return {"status": "UNKNOWN_ACTION"}
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: production
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito user pool + secretless public app client (authorizer identity source)
  # No OAuth flow is enabled: the client exists only to provide the issuer and
  # the client_id audience consumed by the gateway's CUSTOM_JWT authorizer.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-users'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Environment: production
        ManagedBy: CloudFormation

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AgentCore gateway execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Audit events ingestion queue with customer-managed KMS encryption and key rotation,
  an environment-gated dead letter queue, CloudWatch alarms for queue age and DLQ
  activity, and an SNS alert topic. All dependencies (KMS key, queues, topic, alarms,
  policies) are created inside this template; nothing external is referenced.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Approach notes
#
# Objective 9 (conditional RedrivePolicy):
#   RedrivePolicy cannot simply be omitted, so it is supplied through an Fn::If that
#   returns the full redrive map for staging/prod and AWS::NoValue for dev. The DLQ
#   resource, the DLQ CloudWatch alarm and the DLQ outputs are all gated by the same
#   CreateDlq condition, so a dev deployment neither creates nor references the DLQ.
#
# Objective 17 (queue policy):
#   No AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy is created. Only IAM-authorized principals in this
#   account are expected to publish audit events; no external principal (SNS,
#   EventBridge, another account) targets the queue. If an external principal is
#   added later, attach an AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy granting sqs:SendMessage.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment that drives all environment-specific behavior.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

  AppName:
    Type: String
    Description: Short application name used as a prefix for collision-free resource names.
    Default: audit
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'

  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Optional email address subscribed to the alarm SNS topic. Leave empty to deploy
      without a subscription and add subscribers after deployment.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'

Conditions:
  CreateDlq: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref Environment, staging]
    - !Equals [!Ref Environment, prod]

  HasNotificationEmail: !Not
    - !Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    dev:
      AuditMessageRetentionPeriod: 345600
      AuditVisibilityTimeout: 60
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      DlqVisibilityTimeout: 60
      MaxReceiveCount: 3
      OldestMessageAgeThresholdSeconds: 900
    staging:
      AuditMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      AuditVisibilityTimeout: 300
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      DlqVisibilityTimeout: 300
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
      OldestMessageAgeThresholdSeconds: 1800
    prod:
      AuditMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      AuditVisibilityTimeout: 300
      DlqMessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      DlqVisibilityTimeout: 300
      MaxReceiveCount: 5
      OldestMessageAgeThresholdSeconds: 3600

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key (encryption + annual rotation) with Retain policies
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditEventsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CMK for ${AppName} audit event queues and alarm topic (${Environment})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountRootFullAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  AuditEventsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AppName}-audit-events-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Primary audit events queue (CMK encrypted; retention/visibility via mapping)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AppName}-audit-events-${Environment}'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, AuditMessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, AuditVisibilityTimeout]
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - CreateDlq
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditDlq.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MaxReceiveCount]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dead letter queue (staging/prod only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: CreateDlq
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AppName}-audit-events-dlq-${Environment}'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, DlqMessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, DlqVisibilityTimeout]
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm notification topic (encrypted, optional email subscription)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AppName}-audit-events-alarms-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
      Subscription:
        - !If
          - HasNotificationEmail
          - Protocol: email
            Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*'
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - sns:GetTopicAttributes
              - sns:SetTopicAttributes
              - sns:AddPermission
              - sns:RemovePermission
              - sns:DeleteTopic
              - sns:Subscribe
              - sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarms: oldest audit message age + any DLQ activity
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AuditQueueOldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-audit-events-oldest-message-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Oldest message on the ${AppName} audit events queue exceeded the ${Environment} age threshold.'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, OldestMessageAgeThresholdSeconds]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  AuditDlqMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateDlq
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AppName}-audit-events-dlq-messages-${Environment}'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Failed audit messages are visible in the ${AppName} DLQ (${Environment}).'
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditDlq.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      InsufficientDataActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  AuditQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the audit events SQS queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditQueue

  AuditQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events SQS queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn

  AuditDlqUrl:
    Condition: CreateDlq
    Description: URL of the audit events dead letter queue (staging/prod only).
    Value: !Ref AuditDlq

  AuditDlqArn:
    Condition: CreateDlq
    Description: ARN of the audit events dead letter queue (staging/prod only).
    Value: !GetAtt AuditDlq.Arn

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic that receives audit alarm notifications.
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key used for queue and topic encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the customer-managed KMS key.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsKeyAlias

  AuditQueueOldestMessageAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch alarm monitoring the oldest audit message age.
    Value: !Ref AuditQueueOldestMessageAlarm

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL API that fetches cryptocurrency ticker prices from the CoinGecko public API and stores price history in DynamoDB.

Resources:

  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: false

  AppSyncDynamoDBAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: APIDataTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${APIDataTable.Arn}/index/*'

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type TickerInfo {
          ticker: String!
          price: Float
          timestamp: String
          priceHistory(ticker: String!, limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [TickerInfo]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type Query {
          ticker(ticker: String!): TickerInfo
        }

  DynamoDBDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableDataSource
      Description: DynamoDB backend that stores ticker price history
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBAccessRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Description: Public CoinGecko HTTP endpoint used to read current ticker prices
      Type: HTTP
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3

  FetchTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: fetchTickerPrice
      Description: Calls the CoinGecko simple/price endpoint for the requested ticker
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": "$ctx.args.ticker",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            },
            "headers": {
              "Accept": "application/json"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($util.parseJson($ctx.result.body))

  StoreTickerPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: storeTickerPrice
      Description: Persists the fetched USD price as a historical record in APIDataTable
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($ticker = $ctx.args.ticker)
        #set($entry = $ctx.prev.result.get($ticker))
        #if($util.isNullOrEmpty($entry))
          $util.error("No price data was returned for ticker $ticker", "PriceNotFound")
        #end
        #set($price = $entry.get("usd"))
        #set($timestamp = $util.time.nowISO8601())
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("ticker", $ticker))
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("price", $price))
        $util.qr($ctx.stash.put("timestamp", $timestamp))
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ticker),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson("PRICE#${timestamp}")
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ticker),
            "priceUsd": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($price),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($timestamp)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson({
          "ticker": $ctx.stash.get("ticker"),
          "price": $ctx.stash.get("price"),
          "timestamp": $ctx.stash.get("timestamp")
        })

  TickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt StoreTickerPriceFunction.FunctionId
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Invoke",
          "payload": {}
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($limit = $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25))
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "Query",
          "query": {
            "expression": "hk = :hk",
            "expressionValues": {
              ":hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.ticker)
            }
          },
          "scanIndexForward": false,
          "limit": $limit
          #if($ctx.args.nextToken)
          ,"nextToken": $util.toJson($ctx.args.nextToken)
          #end
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #set($items = [])
        #foreach($item in $ctx.result.items)
          $util.qr($items.add({
            "ticker": $item.ticker,
            "price": $item.priceUsd,
            "timestamp": $item.timestamp
          }))
        #end
        $util.toJson({
          "items": $items,
          "nextToken": $ctx.result.nextToken
        })

  CryptoTickerAPIApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn:
      - GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
