final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  MediaPackage live streaming channel with HLS and DASH origin endpoints
  (start-over playback plus optional live-to-VOD origination DENY) and optional
  MediaPackage VOD packaging workflows backed by template-created,
  customer-managed-key encrypted, versioned S3 buckets and a least-privilege
  IAM role for the mediapackage.amazonaws.com service principal.

Parameters:

  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: mediapackage
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 25
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$'
    Description: >-
      Logical name prefix applied to every resource created by this template.

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: >-
      Origin endpoints and VOD packaging configurations to create. APPLE_HLS
      creates the HLS endpoint, ISO_DASH creates the DASH endpoint, ALL creates both.

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$'
    Description: Manifest name used by both the HLS and DASH origin endpoints.

  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Segment duration in seconds used by the HLS origin endpoint.

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 60
    MaxValue: 86400
    Description: >-
      Start-over (catch-up) window in seconds applied to the HLS origin endpoint.

  EnableLiveToVod:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >-
      When true, origin endpoints use DENY origination so MediaPackage archives
      live content in the archive bucket for live-to-VOD instead of serving it
      directly to viewers.

  EnableVodWorkflow:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >-
      When true, the VOD source bucket, MediaPackage packaging group, packaging
      configuration, asset and the cross-service IAM role are created.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Environment name applied to every taggable resource.

  CustomTags:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+=[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(,[A-Za-z0-9._-]+=[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)*$'
    Description: >-
      Up to two comma-delimited "key=value" custom tags, for example
      "CostCenter=1234,Owner=media".

  ArchiveBucketSuffix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$'
    Description: >-
      Optional suffix appended to the generated live-to-VOD archive bucket name.

  VodSourceBucketSuffix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$'
    Description: >-
      Optional suffix appended to the generated VOD source bucket name.

Conditions:

  CreateHlsEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]

  CreateDashEndpoint: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]

  UseArchiveOrigination: !Equals [!Ref EnableLiveToVod, 'true']

  CreateVodWorkflow: !Equals [!Ref EnableVodWorkflow, 'true']

  HasCustomTag1: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]
      - ''

  HasCustomTag2: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]
      - ''

Resources:

  MediaPackageCmk:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for MediaPackage S3 buckets used by ${NamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-cmk'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  MediaPackageCmkAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-mediapackage'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MediaPackageCmk

  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-channel'
      Description: !Sub 'Live streaming channel for ${NamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      HlsIngest:
        ingestEndpoints:
          - Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ingest-a'
          - Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ingest-b'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-channel'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-hls'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub 'HLS origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [UseArchiveOrigination, DENY, ALLOW]
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistType: EVENT
        AdMarkers: NONE
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-hls'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-dash'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub 'DASH origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Origination: !If [UseArchiveOrigination, DENY, ALLOW]
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        ManifestLayout: FULL
        SegmentTemplateFormat: NUMBER_WITH_TIMELINE
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-dash'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-archive-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}${ArchiveBucketSuffix}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageCmk.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-archive-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}${ArchiveBucketSuffix}'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  ArchiveBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageServiceAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-source-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}${VodSourceBucketSuffix}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageCmk.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-source-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}${VodSourceBucketSuffix}'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  VodSourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageServiceAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  MediaPackageVodRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-vod-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Allows MediaPackage to read VOD source content and read/write live-to-VOD archives for ${NamePrefix}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowMediaPackageAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-s3-access'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListTemplateBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
                  - !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
              - Sid: ReadWriteTemplateObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !Sub '${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: UseCustomerManagedKey
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MediaPackageCmk.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-mediapackage-vod-role'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  VodPackagingGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingGroup
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-packaging-group'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-packaging-group'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  VodPackagingConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::PackagingConfiguration
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-packaging-config'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      HlsPackage: !If
        - CreateHlsEndpoint
        - HlsManifests:
            - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
              RepeatExtXKey: false
          SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      DashPackage: !If
        - CreateDashEndpoint
        - DashManifests:
            - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
              ManifestLayout: FULL
          SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
          SegmentTemplateFormat: NUMBER_WITH_TIMELINE
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-packaging-config'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  VodAsset:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Asset
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-asset'
      PackagingGroupId: !Ref VodPackagingGroup
      SourceArn: !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
      SourceRoleArn: !GetAtt MediaPackageVodRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-vod-asset'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag1
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [0, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag2
          - Key: !Select [0, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
            Value: !Select [1, !Split ['=', !Select [1, !Split [',', !Sub '${CustomTags},,']]]]
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

Outputs:

  ChannelId:
    Description: ID of the MediaPackage live streaming channel.
    Value: !Ref MediaPackageChannel

  ChannelArn:
    Description: ARN of the MediaPackage live streaming channel.
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageChannel.Arn

  HlsOriginEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the HLS origin endpoint.
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Value: !Ref HlsOriginEndpoint

  HlsOriginEndpointUrl:
    Description: URL of the HLS origin endpoint.
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Value: !GetAtt HlsOriginEndpoint.Url

  DashOriginEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the DASH origin endpoint.
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Value: !Ref DashOriginEndpoint

  DashOriginEndpointUrl:
    Description: URL of the DASH origin endpoint.
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Value: !GetAtt DashOriginEndpoint.Url

  ArchiveBucketName:
    Description: Name of the live-to-VOD archive S3 bucket.
    Value: !Ref ArchiveBucket

  ArchiveBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the live-to-VOD archive S3 bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn

  VodSourceBucketName:
    Description: Name of the VOD source content S3 bucket.
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Value: !Ref VodSourceBucket

  VodSourceBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the VOD source content S3 bucket.
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Value: !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn

  MediaPackageVodRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by MediaPackage for live-to-VOD and VOD packaging.
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageVodRole.Arn

  VodPackagingGroupId:
    Description: ID of the MediaPackage VOD packaging group.
    Condition: CreateVodWorkflow
    Value: !Ref VodPackagingGroup

  MediaPackageCmkArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the MediaPackage S3 buckets.
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageCmk.Arn

  MediaPackageCmkAliasName:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >-
  IAM roles, instance profiles, and customer/AWS managed policies that allow the
  Cluster API Provider AWS (CAPA) to manage EC2-based and EKS-based Kubernetes
  cluster lifecycles.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: capa
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-_]*$"
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must begin with an alphanumeric character and may contain only alphanumeric
      characters, hyphens, and underscores.
    Description: >-
      Prefix applied to the names and tags of the IAM resources created by this
      template so that they can be identified and cleaned up.

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # CAPA control plane (EC2-based clusters)
  ###############################################################################

  ControlPlanePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-capa-control-plane-policy"
      Description: >-
        Broad permissions used by the CAPA control plane to manage EC2, Elastic
        Load Balancing, Auto Scaling, and KMS resources.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSnapshot
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeVolumesModifications
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVolume
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:DetachLoadBalancerFromSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: KMS
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:GenerateRandom
              - kms:ListKeys
              - kms:ListResourceTags
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:TagResource
            Resource: "*"

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-capa-control-plane"
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by EC2 instances that run the CAPA control plane and drive
        the lifecycle of EC2-based workload clusters.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2ToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControlPlanePolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEKSPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-capa-control-plane"
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-capa-control-plane"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ###############################################################################
  # CAPA controllers
  ###############################################################################

  ControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-capa-controllers-policy"
      Description: >-
        Permissions used by the CAPA controllers to manage VPC networking,
        security groups, load balancers, Auto Scaling groups, launch templates,
        and EKS access entries.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2Networking
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeVpcAttribute
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: LaunchTemplates
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:ApplySecurityGroupsToLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:AttachLoadBalancerToSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancerPolicies
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups

              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesForBackendServer
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetLoadBalancerPoliciesOfListener
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: EKSAccessEntries
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
              - eks:UpdateAccessEntry
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: CreateServiceLinkedRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - autoscaling.amazonaws.com
                  - elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: PassRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*"

  ControllersEKSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: controllers-eks
      Description: >-
        Additional permissions used by the CAPA controllers and control plane to
        manage EKS clusters, node groups, and Fargate profiles.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EKSClusters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: EKSNodegroups
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeUpdate

            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-fargate.amazonaws.com

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-capa-controllers"
      Description: >-
        Role assumed by the CAPA controllers running on EC2 as well as by the
        CAPA controllers running as EKS pods.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2ToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowEKSPodsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref ControllersPolicy
        - !Ref ControllersEKSPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

        - Key: Project

    Properties:

      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

              - ec2:DescribeTags

              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ECR

          - Sid: S3

              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: "*"

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-capa-nodes"
      Description: Role assumed by CAPA managed workload cluster nodes.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2ToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy"
        - !Ref NodesPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-capa-nodes"
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-capa-nodes"
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  ###############################################################################
  # Amazon EKS control plane
  ###############################################################################

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-capa-eks-control-plane"

  x86_64 and arm64 architectures, installing Docker, the Docker Compose plugin,

    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organizations ID such as o-a1b2c3d4e5
    Description: AWS Organizations ID that the resulting AMIs are shared with.

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # Customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the Image Builder build logs.
  # The key policy intentionally references NO template resource: access for
  # the build/service roles is delegated by the account-root statement and
  # granted through their own IAM identity policies. This keeps the resource
  # dependency graph acyclic.
  ###########################################################################
  LogBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for EC2 Image Builder build log encryption.
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountRootFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ###########################################################################
  # S3 bucket used to store Image Builder build logs (SSE-KMS with the CMK)
  ###########################################################################
  LogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'imagebuilder-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt LogBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  LogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt LogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${LogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  ###########################################################################
  # IAM role assumed by the EC2 build instances launched by Image Builder
  ###########################################################################
  BuildInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-role'
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder build instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilderECRContainerBuilds'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BuildLogBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BuildLogBucketObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
                Resource: !Sub '${LogBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: BuildLogBucketList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource: !GetAtt LogBucket.Arn
              - Sid: BuildLogBucketKeyUsage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt LogBucketKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  BuildInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceRole

  ###########################################################################
  # IAM role assumed by the Image Builder service itself
  ###########################################################################
  ImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-imagebuilder-service-role'
      Description: Role assumed by the EC2 Image Builder service to orchestrate builds.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ImageBuilderApiAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'imagebuilder:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Ec2BuildAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:RunInstances'
                  - 'ec2:TerminateInstances'
                  - 'ec2:StopInstances'
                  - 'ec2:StartInstances'
                  - 'ec2:CreateTags'
                  - 'ec2:DeleteTags'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeImages'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeImageAttribute'
                  - 'ec2:ModifyImageAttribute'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeInstances'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeSubnets'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeVpcs'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions'
                  - 'ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate'
                  - 'ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate'
                  - 'ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion'
                  - 'ec2:DescribeTags'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassRoleToBuildInstances
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt BuildInstanceRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService': 'ec2.amazonaws.com'
              - Sid: BuildLogAndArtifactAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LogBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${LogBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: BuildLogBucketKeyUsage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt LogBucketKey.Arn
              - Sid: SupportingServices
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'sns:Publish'
                  - 'ssm:GetParameter'
                  - 'ssm:GetParameters'
                  - 'ssm:PutParameter'
                  - 'iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole'
                  - 'iam:GetRole'
                  - 'iam:GetInstanceProfile'
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ###########################################################################
  # Image Builder component: install Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages
  # and enable passwordless sudo for the SSM user.
  # The component Name must not contain dots, so the semantic version is
  # carried only by the Version property and surfaced in Description/Tags.
  ###########################################################################
  InstallSoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-install-software'
      Description: >-
        Installs Docker Engine, the Docker Compose plugin and the Python packages
        synapseclient, pandas and pysftp, and enables passwordless sudo for the
        ssm-user on Amazon Linux 2023.
      ChangeDescription: Initial version of the software installation component.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - 'Amazon Linux 2023'
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
        ImageVersion: !Ref ImageVersion
      Data: |
        name: InstallSoftware
        description: Installs Docker, the Docker Compose plugin, Python packages and configures ssm-user sudo access.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallSystemPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf update -y
                    - dnf install -y docker python3 python3-pip curl
                    - systemctl enable docker
              - name: InstallDockerComposePlugin
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
                    - ARCH="$(uname -m)"
                    - curl -fsSL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-${ARCH}" -o /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod +x /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - ln -sf /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
                    - python3 -m pip install synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: ConfigureSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - id ssm-user >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash ssm-user
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
              - name: StartDockerService
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - systemctl start docker

  ###########################################################################
  # Image Builder component: test phase verifying Docker Compose and the
  # Python imports. Name contains no dots; version is in the Version property.
  ###########################################################################
  ValidateSoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-validate-software'
      Description: >-
        Runs a test phase that verifies the Docker Compose plugin works and that
        synapseclient, pandas and pysftp can be imported from Python 3.
      ChangeDescription: Initial version of the software validation component.
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - 'Amazon Linux 2023'
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
        ImageVersion: !Ref ImageVersion
      Data: |
        name: ValidateSoftware
        description: Validates Docker Compose and the Python package imports on the built image.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: ValidateDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - docker compose version
              - name: ValidatePythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient"
                    - python3 -c "import pandas"
                    - python3 -c "import pysftp"

  ###########################################################################
  # Image recipes: Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 and arm64
  # The parent image is resolved from the Image Builder managed-image ARN with
  # the "x.x.x" wildcard so the latest AL2023 build is always used. No AMI ID
  # is referenced or hardcoded anywhere in this template.
  ###########################################################################
  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86-64-recipe'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 recipe with Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages.
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86_64/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ValidateSoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ArmImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64-recipe'
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 recipe with Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages.
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref InstallSoftwareComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ValidateSoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ###########################################################################
  # Shared infrastructure configuration used by both architectures.
  # No VPC / subnet / security group is referenced: this is a greenfield
  # account and Image Builder uses the account default VPC.
  ###########################################################################
  InfraConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config'
      Description: Shared infrastructure configuration for the x86_64 and arm64 builds.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile
      # Both an x86_64 and an arm64 instance type are offered so the service can
      # select the type matching the architecture of the recipe being built.
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
        - t4g.medium
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref LogBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}/imagebuilder-logs'
      ResourceTags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ###########################################################################
  # Single distribution configuration: public launch permissions plus
  # organization-level sharing, with AMI name and tags applied.
  ###########################################################################
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-distribution-config'
      Description: Publishes the AMIs publicly and shares them with the configured AWS Organization.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMI built with Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages.
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${OrganizationId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
              BuiltBy: EC2ImageBuilder
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ###########################################################################
  # Pipelines: one per architecture, sharing the infrastructure and
  # distribution configurations.
  # NOTE: ExecutionRole is part of the AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
  # CloudFormation resource specification. If the specification in the target
  # region does not expose it, remove the ExecutionRole property and let the
  # Image Builder service-linked role run the pipeline.
  ###########################################################################
  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-x86-64-pipeline'
      Description: Builds, tests and distributes the x86_64 Amazon Linux 2023 image.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref X86ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfraConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderRole.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 2 ? * SUN *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ArmImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-arm64-pipeline'
      Description: Builds, tests and distributes the arm64 Amazon Linux 2023 image.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref ArmImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfraConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderRole.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 2 ? * SUN *)'
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !Ref X86ImagePipeline

  ArmImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !Ref ArmImagePipeline

  X86ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the x86_64 Image Builder image recipe.
    Value: !Ref X86ImageRecipe

  ArmImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the arm64 Image Builder image recipe.
    Value: !Ref ArmImageRecipe

  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared Image Builder distribution configuration.
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration

  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared Image Builder infrastructure configuration.
    Value: !Ref InfraConfiguration

  ImageBuilderExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the Image Builder service.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageBuilderRole.Arn

  BuildInstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the instance profile used by the build instances.
    Value: !Ref BuildInstanceProfile

  LogBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket holding the Image Builder build logs.
    Value: !Ref LogBucket

  LogBucketKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the Image Builder build logs.
    Value: !GetAtt LogBucketKey.Arn

  LogBucketKeyId:
    Description: ID of the customer managed KMS key encrypting the Image Builder build logs.
    Value: !Ref LogBucketKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  AnyCompany Hotel authentication platform - Amazon Cognito user pool (PLUS tier with
  enforced advanced security) for guest and staff identities, public SPA and admin
  auth clients, machine-to-machine OAuth2 client with a custom resource server, staff
  role groups, and a Cognito prefix domain for OAuth2 token endpoints.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment for the AnyCompany Hotel authentication stack.
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

Resources:

  HotelUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'anycompany-hotel-userpool-${Environment}'
      UserPoolTier: PLUS
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
        UnusedAccountValidityDays: 7
        InviteMessageTemplate:
          EmailSubject: 'AnyCompany Hotel - Your account invitation'
          EmailMessage: 'Your AnyCompany Hotel username is {username} and your temporary password is {####}.'
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cognito identity stack for the Hospitality Insights application in the prod environment:
  user pool with a custom last_login attribute, a Python 3.12 post-authentication Lambda
  trigger, an application client with a 24-hour refresh-token session, Admin/RegularUser/
  PowerUser groups, a Cognito prefix hosted UI domain, and optional federated SSO.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; must start and end with a letter or number.
    Description: Application name used to name and tag the resources created by this stack.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment of the Hospitality Insights identity stack.
  HostedUIDomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hosted-ui
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only; must start and end with a letter or number.
    Description: Prefix of the hosted UI domain; combined with the application name and account ID for global uniqueness.
  SsoLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|https://.*)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Leave empty to disable SSO, or supply an https:// OIDC issuer (login) URL.
    Description: Optional SSO/OIDC issuer login URL. Left empty by default so SSO is disabled.
  SsoProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Leave empty to disable SSO, or supply the federated identity provider name.
    Description: Optional federated identity provider name. Left empty by default so SSO is disabled.
  SsoClientId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Leave empty when SSO is disabled, or supply the OAuth client ID issued by the provider.
    Description: OAuth client ID issued by the SSO provider (only used when SSO is enabled).
  SsoClientSecret:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    NoEcho: true
    Description: OAuth client secret issued by the SSO provider (only used when SSO is enabled). Never stored in the template.

Conditions:
  EnableSso: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoLoginUrl, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoProviderName, '']]

Resources:

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 14
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 3
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref ApplicationName
        Environment: !Ref EnvironmentName

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 24
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: hours
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
      SupportedIdentityProviders: !If
        - EnableSso
        - - COGNITO
          - !Ref SsoIdentityProvider
        - - COGNITO

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: Administrators with full access to Hospitality Insights.
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      Description: Standard users of the Hospitality Insights application.
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      Description: Advanced users with elevated Hospitality Insights capabilities.
      Precedence: 3
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${HostedUIDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  SsoIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: EnableSso
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SsoProviderName
      ProviderType: OIDC
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Ref SsoClientId
        client_secret: !Ref SsoClientSecret
        oidc_issuer: !Ref SsoLoginUrl
        authorize_scopes: openid email profile
        attributes_request_method: GET
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
        name: name

  PostAuthenticationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-post-authentication'
      Description: Cognito post-authentication trigger that records custom:last_login.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunctionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 10
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          """Cognito PostAuthentication trigger that stamps the custom:last_login attribute."""
          import logging
          import os
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3

          LOGGER = logging.getLogger()
          LOGGER.setLevel(os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))

          COGNITO_IDP = boto3.client("cognito-idp")

          LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE = "custom:last_login"


          def handler(event, context):
              """Update custom:last_login for the user that just signed in.

              The post-authentication trigger payload carries the user pool ID and
              the user's sub, so no user pool identifier is required at deploy time.
              This function never calls an authentication API (no InitiateAuth or
              AdminInitiateAuth) and only acts on the authentication trigger source,
              so it cannot re-trigger itself into an infinite loop.
              """
              if event.get("triggerSource") != "PostAuthentication_Authentication":
                  return event

              user_pool_id = event.get("userPoolId")
              user_attributes = event.get("request", {}).get("userAttributes", {})
              username = user_attributes.get("sub") or event.get("userName")

              if not user_pool_id or not username:
                  LOGGER.warning("Missing user pool ID or username, skipping last_login update")
                  return event

              timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds")

              try:
                  COGNITO_IDP.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {"Name": LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE, "Value": timestamp}
                      ],
                  )
                  LOGGER.info("Updated %s for %s", LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE, username)
              except Exception:
                  LOGGER.exception("Failed to update %s for %s", LAST_LOGIN_ATTRIBUTE, username)

              return event

  PostAuthenticationFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-post-authentication-role'
      Description: Execution role for the Cognito post-authentication trigger function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoLastLoginUpdate
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AdminUpdateUserAttributesOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PostAuthenticationFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${ApplicationName}-${EnvironmentName}-post-authentication'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  PostAuthenticationFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthenticationFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool for Hospitality Insights.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool application client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  HostedUiLoginUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI login URL for the Cognito prefix domain created by this stack.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/login?client_id=${UserPoolClient}&response_type=code&scope=openid+email+profile'
  SsoProviderName:
    Description: Name of the federated SSO identity provider that is active (empty when SSO is disabled).
    Value: !Ref SsoProviderName
