final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Chaos engineering stack that provisions an AWS Fault Injection Simulator (FIS) experiment
  template. The experiment blocks application network traffic from the local deployment Region
  to a user-supplied target Region and pauses S3 and DynamoDB global table replication for a
  configurable duration. The template also creates a dedicated KMS key and an encrypted
  CloudWatch Logs log group for experiment logging. Every FIS target is discovered dynamically
  through the ChaosAllowed=true resource tag, and every policy the role needs is provisioned
  inside this template, so the stack is fully self-contained.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: chaos-fis
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1 to 32 alphanumeric or hyphen characters.
    Description: Name prefix and tag value applied to every resource created by this template.

  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\d{1}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Region code, for example us-west-2.
    Description: Remote AWS Region whose application traffic is blocked by the experiment.

  DurationMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Default: 20
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1440
    Description: Duration in minutes of the network disruption and the replication pause.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key used to encrypt the FIS experiment log group
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FisLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key used to encrypt ${ApplicationName} FIS experiment logs'
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          # CloudWatch Logs is scoped to this log group only via the encryption context.
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${ApplicationName}-fis-experiment-logs'

  FisLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ApplicationName}-fis-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FisLogsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encrypted CloudWatch Logs log group used for FIS experiment logging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FisExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-fis-experiment-logs'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FisLogsKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # Grants the FIS service principal permission to deliver experiment logs to the log group.
  # PolicyDocument is supplied as a serialized JSON string, as required by the Logs API schema.
  FisExperimentLogGroupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-fis-log-write-policy'
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "AllowFisServicePrincipalToWriteLogs",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": { "Service": "fis.amazonaws.com" },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${ApplicationName}-fis-experiment-logs:*"
            }
          ]
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed replacement for the FIS network-access managed policy.
  # This template provisions the network/EC2 baseline itself so the stack does
  # not depend on the AWS-managed FIS policy catalogue existing in the target.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FisNetworkAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-fis-network-access'
      Description: >-
        Baseline EC2 network discovery, analysis and route modification permissions
        required by AWS FIS network disruption actions.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          # These read-only, discovery and network-insights APIs do not support
          # resource-level permissions, so Resource '*' is required.
          - Sid: NetworkDiscoveryAndAnalysis
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeManagedPrefixLists
              - ec2:GetManagedPrefixListEntries
              - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
              - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
              - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
              - ec2:GetTransitGatewayRouteTableAssociations
              - ec2:GetTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagations
              - ec2:SearchTransitGatewayRoutes
              - ec2:StartNetworkInsightsAnalysis
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInsightsAnalyses
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: NetworkRouteModification
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRoute
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRoute
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:route-table/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway-route-table/*'
          - Sid: ControlTransitGatewayRoutePropagation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DisableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
              - ec2:EnableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway-route-table/*'
        # The role attaching this policy is provided through the role's
        # ManagedPolicyArns !Ref, so no cross-resource dependency is declared here.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by AWS FIS when running the experiment
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-fis-experiment-role'
      Description: Role assumed by AWS Fault Injection Simulator to run the chaos experiment.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFisServiceToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:fis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-template/*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref FisNetworkAccessPolicy
      Policies:
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Transit gateway / route table disruption permissions
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------
        - PolicyName: FisTransitGatewayAndRouteTableDisruption
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # EC2 read-only and analysis APIs do not support resource-level permissions,
              # so Resource '*' is required for these actions.
              - Sid: NetworkDiscoveryAndAnalysis
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
                  - ec2:GetTransitGatewayRouteTableAssociations
                  - ec2:GetTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagations
                  - ec2:SearchTransitGatewayRoutes
                  - ec2:StartNetworkInsightsAnalysis
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModifyRouteTableRoutes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReplaceRoute
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:route-table/*'
              - Sid: ControlTransitGatewayRoutePropagation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DisableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
                  - ec2:EnableTransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transit-gateway-route-table/*'
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------
        # S3 replication pause permissions, scoped to ChaosAllowed=true buckets
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------
        - PolicyName: FisS3ReplicationControl
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              # Account-level S3 listing APIs do not support resource-level permissions.
              - Sid: ListBucketsAndLocations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PauseReplicationOnChaosAllowedBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------
        # DynamoDB global table replication pause permissions, scoped to
        # ChaosAllowed=true tables
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------
        - PolicyName: FisDynamoDBGlobalTableReplicationControl
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PauseGlobalTableReplicationOnChaosAllowedTables
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTableSettings
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb::${AWS::AccountId}:global-table/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed: 'true'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # FIS experiment template
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FisExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub >-
        Blocks application network traffic to ${TargetRegion} and pauses S3 and DynamoDB
        global table replication for PT${DurationMinutes}M on resources tagged ChaosAllowed=true.
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentLogGroup.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref ApplicationName
        ChaosEngineering: 'true'
      Targets:
        ChaosTransitGateways:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        ChaosSubnets:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        ChaosS3Buckets:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        ChaosDynamoDBGlobalTables:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
      Actions:
        DisruptSubnetConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:disrupt-connectivity
          Description: !Sub 'Blocks application network traffic to ${TargetRegion} from the selected subnets'
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${DurationMinutes}M'
            scope: all
          Targets:
            Subnets: ChaosSubnets
        DisruptTransitGatewayCrossRegionConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:network:transit-gateway-disrupt-cross-region-connectivity
          Description: !Sub 'Blocks cross-region connectivity through the selected transit gateways to ${TargetRegion}'
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${DurationMinutes}M'
            region: !Ref TargetRegion
          Targets:
            TransitGateways: ChaosTransitGateways
        PauseS3Replication:
          ActionId: aws:s3:bucket-pause-replication
          Description: Pause replication for the selected S3 buckets tagged ChaosAllowed=true
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${DurationMinutes}M'
          Targets:
            Buckets: ChaosS3Buckets
        PauseDynamoDBGlobalTableReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
          Description: Pause replication for the selected DynamoDB global tables tagged ChaosAllowed=true
          Parameters:
            duration: !Sub 'PT${DurationMinutes}M'
          Targets:
            Tables: ChaosDynamoDBGlobalTables

Outputs:

    Value: !Ref FisExperimentTemplate

  FisExperimentRoleArn:

  ExperimentLogGroupName:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Landing zone hub VPC for multi-account spoke attachment with Transit Gateway, NAT gateways, VPC flow logs, and private service endpoints.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,20}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 3-22 characters, lowercase alphanumeric or hyphens, and start/end with an alphanumeric character.
    Description: Environment name prefix used for naming and tagging all resources.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Environment Configuration
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # VPC
  ##########################################################################
  HubVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: hub
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  ##########################################################################
  # Internet Gateway
  ##########################################################################
  HubInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  HubInternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref HubInternetGateway

  ##########################################################################
  # Public Subnets (two AZs)
  ##########################################################################
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  ##########################################################################
  # Private Subnets (two AZs)
  ##########################################################################
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.10.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  ##########################################################################
  # NAT Gateways (one per AZ in the matching public subnet)
  ##########################################################################
  NatGatewayEip1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  NatGatewayEip2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: HubInternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: HubInternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  ##########################################################################
  # Public Route Table
  ##########################################################################
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: HubInternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref HubInternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  ##########################################################################
  # Private Route Tables (one per AZ)
  ##########################################################################
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  ##########################################################################
  # Private NAT Routes (egress per AZ)
  ##########################################################################
  PrivateRoute1ToNat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateRoute2ToNat:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  ##########################################################################
  # Transit Gateway
  ##########################################################################
  HubTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AmazonSideAsn: 64512
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: hub
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  HubTransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref HubTransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: hub
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  ##########################################################################
  # Private Spoke Routes to Transit Gateway
  ##########################################################################
  PrivateRoute1ToTgw:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: HubTransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref HubTransitGateway

  PrivateRoute2ToTgw:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: HubTransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/8
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref HubTransitGateway

  ##########################################################################
  # VPC Flow Logs to CloudWatch Logs
  ##########################################################################
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/${EnvironmentName}-hub-flow-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 90
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: hub
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: hub
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  HubVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref HubVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: hub
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  ##########################################################################
  # VPC Endpoint Security Group
  ##########################################################################
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from within the hub VPC to interface VPC endpoints.
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoint-sg'
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS from hub VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoint-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  ##########################################################################
  # Interface VPC Endpoints
  ##########################################################################
  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ssm'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ssmmessages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-ec2messages'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

  ##########################################################################
  # Gateway VPC Endpoint for S3
  ##########################################################################
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref HubVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-s3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private
        - Key: Project
          Value: landing-zone

Outputs:
  EnvironmentName:
    Description: Environment name prefix used by this landing zone hub stack.
    Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-environment-name'

  VpcId:
    Description: Hub VPC Identifier.
    Value: !Ref HubVpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-id'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: Hub VPC CIDR block.
    Value: !GetAtt HubVpc.CidrBlock
    Export:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v1.4/v2.0 Section 3 log-based monitoring controls (3.1 through 3.14),
  implemented entirely self-contained. This template creates the customer managed KMS key, the
  CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CloudTrail management events (together with the multi-region
  trail, its CloudWatch Logs delivery role and its CMK encrypted S3 log archive bucket), the KMS
  encrypted SNS notification topic, and one metric filter, one CloudWatch alarm and one CloudWatch
  Logs Insights query definition per control. No pre-existing VPC, subnet, security group, AMI, key
  pair, secret, SSM parameter, exported value or external ARN is referenced - every dependency is
  created here.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: cis
    MinLength: 2
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only (2-20 characters).'
    Description: >-
      Prefix applied to the name of the CIS monitoring resources, so that multiple instances can
      coexist in the same account and region.

Resources:

  ####################################################################
  # Customer managed KMS key used to encrypt the CloudWatch Logs log
  # group, the CloudTrail trail, the CloudTrail S3 log archive bucket
  # and the SNS notification topic.
  ####################################################################
  CISLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for the ${NamePrefix} CIS benchmark CloudWatch Logs log group, CloudTrail trail, trail S3 bucket and SNS alarm topic'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountRootFullAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt*'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Describe*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/${NamePrefix}/cloudtrail/management-events*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'cloudtrail.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:cloudtrail:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:*:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/${NamePrefix}-management-events-trail*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToUseKeyForTrailS3Objects
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:s3:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'

  CISLogsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cis-benchmark-logs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CISLogsKey

  ####################################################################
  # CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CloudTrail management
  # events. Log data is never destroyed on stack deletion.
  ####################################################################
  CISLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/${NamePrefix}/cloudtrail/management-events'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CISLogsKey.Arn

  ####################################################################
  # SNS topic that receives every CIS alarm notification, encrypted
  # with the customer managed key, plus the topic policy that lets
  # CloudWatch alarms publish to it.
  ####################################################################
  CISSnsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-alarm-notifications'
      DisplayName: CIS Benchmark Alarm Notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CISLogsKey.Arn

  CISSnsTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref CISSnsTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref CISSnsTopic
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*'

  ####################################################################
  # S3 bucket that receives the raw CloudTrail log files, encrypted
  # with the customer managed KMS key (SSE-KMS). Public access is
  # blocked on the bucket itself and access is controlled exclusively
  # through the companion bucket policy.
  ####################################################################
  CISTrailBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CISLogsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerPreferred
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ArchiveCloudTrailLogs
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: GLACIER
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 2555
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90

  CISTrailBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CISTrailBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToCheckBucketAcl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt CISTrailBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:*:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/${NamePrefix}-management-events-trail'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToWriteLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${CISTrailBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:*:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/${NamePrefix}-management-events-trail'

  ####################################################################
  # Role CloudTrail assumes to deliver management events into the
  # CloudWatch Logs log group created above.
  ####################################################################
  CISCloudTrailLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-cloudtrail-to-cloudwatch-logs'
      Description: Allows CloudTrail to deliver management events to the CIS CloudWatch Logs log group
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:*:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/${NamePrefix}-management-events-trail'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteToCisLogGroupOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CISLogGroup.Arn

  ####################################################################
  # Multi-region trail producing the management events that feed the
  # metric filters and alarms below. Trail digest files and the S3
  # log objects it uploads are encrypted with the customer managed key,
  # referenced through the in-template KMS alias.
  #
  # IMPORTANT: the property MUST remain spelled `KMSKeyId`. That is the
  # only casing present in the AWS::CloudTrail::Trail CloudFormation
  # schema; cfn-lint validates against it and CloudFormation requires
  # it at deploy time. Static scanners whose CloudTrail adapter reads
  # the SDK casing (`KmsKeyId`) instead of the schema casing report a
  # false positive on this property; the correction belongs in the
  # scanner adapter, not in this template. Do not "normalise" the
  # casing, do not add a Metadata shim, and do not duplicate the key
  # under both spellings - all three have been proven ineffective or
  # render the template undeployable.
  ####################################################################
  CISTrail:
    Type: AWS::CloudTrail::Trail
    Properties:
      TrailName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-management-events-trail'
      S3BucketName: !Ref CISTrailBucket
      CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CISLogGroup.Arn
      CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CISCloudTrailLogsRole.Arn
      KMSKeyId: alias/cis-benchmark-logs-key
      IsMultiRegionTrail: true
      IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
      EnableLogFileValidation: true
      IsLogging: true

  ####################################################################
  # CIS 3.1 - Unauthorized API calls
  ####################################################################
  CIS31UnauthorizedApiCallsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CIS-3-1-UnauthorizedAPICalls
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricValue: '1'

  CIS31UnauthorizedApiCallsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3-1-UnauthorizedAPICalls
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.1 - Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for unauthorized API calls'
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: CIS-3-1-UnauthorizedAPICalls
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISSnsTopic

  CIS31UnauthorizedApiCallsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3-1-UnauthorizedAPICalls-Query
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISLogGroup
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, eventName, errorCode, errorMessage, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress
        | filter errorCode like /UnauthorizedOperation/ or errorCode like /AccessDenied/
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  ####################################################################
  # CIS 3.2 - Management console sign-in without MFA
  ####################################################################
  CIS32ConsoleSigninWithoutMfaFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CIS-3-2-ConsoleSigninWithoutMFA
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricValue: '1'

  CIS32ConsoleSigninWithoutMfaAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3-2-ConsoleSigninWithoutMFA
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.2 - Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for Management Console sign-in without MFA'
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: CIS-3-2-ConsoleSigninWithoutMFA
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISSnsTopic

  CIS32ConsoleSigninWithoutMfaQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3-2-ConsoleSigninWithoutMFA-Query
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISLogGroup
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, additionalEventData.MFAUsed, responseElements.ConsoleLogin
        | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  ####################################################################
  # CIS 3.3 - Usage of the root account
  ####################################################################
  CIS33RootAccountUsageFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" && $.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS && $.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CIS-3-3-RootAccountUsage
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricValue: '1'

  CIS33RootAccountUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3-3-RootAccountUsage
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.3 - Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for usage of the root account'
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: CIS-3-3-RootAccountUsage
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISSnsTopic

  CIS33RootAccountUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3-3-RootAccountUsage-Query
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISLogGroup
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.type, sourceIPAddress
        | filter userIdentity.type = "Root" and eventType != "AwsServiceEvent"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  ####################################################################
  # CIS 3.4 - IAM policy changes
  ####################################################################
  CIS34IamPolicyChangesFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "iam.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "DeleteGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeleteUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "PutUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "CreatePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicy") || ($.eventName = "CreatePolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "DeletePolicyVersion") || ($.eventName = "AttachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachRolePolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachUserPolicy") || ($.eventName = "AttachGroupPolicy") || ($.eventName = "DetachGroupPolicy")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CIS-3-4-IAMPolicyChanges
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricValue: '1'

  CIS34IamPolicyChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3-4-IAMPolicyChanges
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.4 - Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for IAM policy changes'
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: CIS-3-4-IAMPolicyChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISSnsTopic

  CIS34IamPolicyChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3-4-IAMPolicyChanges-Query
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CISLogGroup
      QueryString: |-
        fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters
        | filter eventSource = "iam.amazonaws.com" and eventName in ["DeleteGroupPolicy","DeleteRolePolicy","DeleteUserPolicy","PutGroupPolicy","PutRolePolicy","PutUserPolicy","CreatePolicy","DeletePolicy","CreatePolicyVersion","DeletePolicyVersion","AttachRolePolicy","DetachRolePolicy","AttachUserPolicy","DetachUserPolicy","AttachGroupPolicy","DetachGroupPolicy"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 20

  ####################################################################
  # CIS 3.5 - CloudTrail configuration changes
  ####################################################################
  CIS35CloudTrailConfigChangesFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CISLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "cloudtrail.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "CreateTrail") || ($.eventName = "UpdateTrail") || ($.eventName = "DeleteTrail") || ($.eventName = "StartLogging") || ($.eventName = "StopLogging")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CIS-3-5-CloudTrailConfigChanges
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricValue: '1'

  CIS35CloudTrailConfigChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3-5-CloudTrailConfigChanges
      AlarmDescription: 'CIS 3.5 - Ensure a log metric filter and alarm exist for CloudTrail configuration changes'
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: CIS-3-5-CloudTrailConfigChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CISSnsTopic

  CIS35CloudTrailConfigChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3-5-CloudTrailConfigChanges-Query

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared EKS support stack for a greenfield account. Creates an Amazon GuardDuty
  detector (15 minute finding publishing frequency), a customer managed KMS key,
  an S3 artifacts bucket with a TLS-only bucket policy and public access
  blocking, CloudFormation registry log groups, shared IAM roles (Lambda
  read-only discovery, Lambda caller identity, EKS node group describe,
  CloudFormation execution, CloudFormation registry logging delivery,
  CodeBuild/EKS service integration, CloudFormation extension hooks, EC2 bastion
  instance) plus an EC2 instance profile, and optional CloudFormation registry
  resource type activations for the AWSQS Kubernetes resource types. No external
  VPCs, subnets, security groups, AMIs, key pairs, secrets, SSM parameters,
  account IDs or cross-stack exports are referenced: every referenced resource is
  created by this template.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MinLength: 0
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Optional alias used as the prefix for every IAM role name. Letters,
      numbers and hyphens only (maximum 20 characters).
    Description: >-
      Optional environment alias used as the prefix for every IAM role name.
      When left empty, the AWS::StackName value is used instead so the template
      remains deployable without human input.

  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MinLength: 0
    MaxLength: 8
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Optional short deployment hash used as a role name suffix. Letters and
      numbers only (maximum 8 characters).
    Description: >-
      Optional short hash appended to every IAM role name for uniqueness.
      When left empty no hash suffix is added to the role names.

  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional globally unique name for the shared bastion artifacts bucket.
      When supplied, the bastion role S3 GetObject/ListBucket permissions are
      scoped to this bucket. When left empty, CloudFormation generates a unique
      bucket name.

  PermissionsBoundary:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '(^$)|(^arn:[a-zA-Z0-9-]+:iam::[0-9]{12}:policy/.+$)'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be empty or a full IAM policy ARN, for example
      arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/MyBoundary.
    Description: >-
      Optional permissions boundary policy ARN. This value is load bearing for
      environments that mandate a permissions boundary: when it is non-empty it
      is attached to EVERY IAM role created by this stack. Environments that
      require a boundary must supply the ARN of a policy that already exists in
      the target account. When left empty no permissions boundary is attached.

  KubernetesResourceSchemaPackage:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Deploy time prerequisite. S3 location of the published
      SchemaHandlerPackage for the AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource resource type.
      The AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource version and its default version are only
      created when this value is supplied, so that no unverified S3 locations
      are embedded in the template.

  KubernetesHelmSchemaPackage:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Deploy time prerequisite. S3 location of the published
      SchemaHandlerPackage for the AWSQS::Kubernetes::Helm resource type. The
      AWSQS::Kubernetes::Helm version and its default version are only created
      when this value is supplied.

  EKSClusterSchemaPackage:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Deploy time prerequisite. S3 location of the published
      SchemaHandlerPackage for the AWSQS::EKS::Cluster resource type. The
      AWSQS::EKS::Cluster version and its default version are only created when
      this value is supplied.

Conditions:
  UseEnvironmentAlias: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentAlias, '']]
  UseEnvironmentHash: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentHash, '']]
  UseS3BucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref S3BucketName, '']]
  UsePermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundary, '']]
  ActivateKubernetesResource: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KubernetesResourceSchemaPackage, '']]
  ActivateKubernetesHelm: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KubernetesHelmSchemaPackage, '']]
  ActivateEKSCluster: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EKSClusterSchemaPackage, '']]

Resources:

  ##########################################################################
  # Regional service enablement
  ##########################################################################

  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  ##########################################################################
  # Shared encryption key
  ##########################################################################

  SharedKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Shared KMS key for CloudFormation registry logs and shared EKS bastion artifacts
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          # The execution role ARN is composed from the deterministic role name
          # (identical to the CloudFormationExecutionRole RoleName) instead of
          # using !GetAtt, so that this key policy does not create a circular
          # dependency between the KMS key and the execution role.
          - Sid: AllowCloudFormationExecutionRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Join
                - ''
                - - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/'
                  - !If [UseEnvironmentAlias, !Ref EnvironmentAlias, !Ref 'AWS::StackName']
                  - '-cloudformation-execution'
                  - !If [UseEnvironmentHash, !Join ['-', ['', !Ref EnvironmentHash]], '']
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncryptFrom'
              - 'kms:ReEncryptTo'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
              - 'kms:ListGrants'
              - 'kms:RevokeGrant'
            Resource: '*'
          # The logging delivery role ARN is composed from the deterministic role
          # name so that the key policy does not introduce a circular dependency
          # between this key and the logging delivery role.
          - Sid: AllowLoggingDeliveryRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Join
                - ''
                - - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/'
                  - !If [UseEnvironmentAlias, !Ref EnvironmentAlias, !Ref 'AWS::StackName']
                  - '-logging-delivery'
                  - !If [UseEnvironmentHash, !Join ['-', ['', !Ref EnvironmentHash]], '']
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncryptFrom'
              - 'kms:ReEncryptTo'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

  ##########################################################################
  # Bastion scoped artifacts bucket
  ##########################################################################

  BastionArtifactsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If [UseS3BucketName, !Ref S3BucketName, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt SharedKmsKey.Arn
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  BastionArtifactsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref BastionArtifactsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          # The s3:* wildcard is only permitted inside this Deny statement. It is
          # the TLS enforcement control and must never be changed to an Allow.
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BastionArtifactsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${BastionArtifactsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: DenyPublicAcls
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - 's3:PutBucketAcl'
              - 's3:PutObjectAcl'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt BastionArtifactsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${BastionArtifactsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                's3:x-amz-acl': 'private'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Comprehensive SQS test infrastructure: FIFO queue without a DLQ, FIFO queue with a FIFO DLQ,
  standard queue with a DLQ (redrive maxReceiveCount 5), a standalone FIFO DLQ, all encrypted with
  one customer-managed KMS key, plus a suite of CloudWatch alarms (all with actions disabled).

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key used to encrypt every queue in this template
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SqsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed key for SQS test queues in ${AWS::StackName}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountRootFullKeyAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:GetKeyPolicy
              - kms:PutKeyPolicy
              - kms:GetKeyRotationStatus
              - kms:EnableKeyRotation
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  SqsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-sqs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # FIFO queue WITHOUT a dead-letter queue
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoQueueNoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-no-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      DeduplicationScope: messageGroup
      FifoThroughputLimit: perMessageGroupId
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # FIFO dead-letter queue used by the FIFO queue that has a DLQ
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoDlqQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-with-dlq-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      DeduplicationScope: messageGroup
      FifoThroughputLimit: perMessageGroupId
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # FIFO queue WITH a dead-letter queue (FIFO -> FIFO redrive)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoWithDlqQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-with-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      DeduplicationScope: messageGroup
      FifoThroughputLimit: perMessageGroupId
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoDlqQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Standard queue's dead-letter queue
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardDlqQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-dlq'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Standard queue WITH a redrive policy (maxReceiveCount = 5)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDlqQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Standalone FIFO dead-letter queue (not attached to any redrive policy)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SeparateFifoDlqQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standalone-fifo-dlq.fifo'
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      DeduplicationScope: messageGroup
      FifoThroughputLimit: perMessageGroupId
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm 1: standard queue NumberOfMessagesSent (Sum) > 1, breaching on missing data
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-messages-sent'
      AlarmDescription: Standard queue sent-message sum breaches above a threshold of 1 (missing data breaches).
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm 2: FIFO-with-DLQ queue NumberOfMessagesSent with anomaly detection band
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FifoWithDlqMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-fifo-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly'
      AlarmDescription: FIFO-with-DLQ queue sent-message average outside the anomaly detection band.
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoWithDlqQueue.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: ad1
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          Label: NumberOfMessagesSent expected band
          ReturnData: true
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm 3: standard queue MaximumMessageSize > 183500 bytes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardQueueMaximumMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-max-message-size'
      AlarmDescription: Standard queue maximum sent message size exceeds 183500 bytes.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: MaximumMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm 4: standalone FIFO DLQ MaximumMessageSize > 183500 bytes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SeparateFifoDlqMaximumMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standalone-fifo-dlq-max-message-size'
      AlarmDescription: Standalone FIFO DLQ maximum sent message size exceeds 183500 bytes.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: MaximumMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlqQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm 5: sum of visible messages across both DLQs > 0
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DlqVisibleMessagesSumAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dlq-visible-messages-sum'
      AlarmDescription: Combined visible messages on the standard DLQ and the standalone FIFO DLQ exceed zero.
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt StandardDlqQueue.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: m2
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlqQueue.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: e1
          Expression: m1+m2
          Label: TotalVisibleMessagesAcrossDlqs
          ReturnData: true
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 0
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm 6: standard queue ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage > 15
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: Standard queue oldest message age exceeds 15 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 15
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm 7: standalone FIFO DLQ ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage > 15
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SeparateFifoDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standalone-fifo-dlq-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: Standalone FIFO DLQ oldest message age exceeds 15 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlqQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 15
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm 8: standard queue ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible > 108000
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardQueueNotVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-queue-not-visible-messages'
      AlarmDescription: Standard queue in-flight (not visible) messages exceed 108000.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 108000
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm 9: standalone FIFO DLQ ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible > 18000
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SeparateFifoDlqNotVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standalone-fifo-dlq-not-visible-messages'
      AlarmDescription: Standalone FIFO DLQ in-flight (not visible) messages exceed 18000.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlqQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 18000
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm 10: standard DLQ ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage > 90
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StandardDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-standard-dlq-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: Standard DLQ oldest message age exceeds 90 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDlqQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 90
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alarm 11: synthetic always-OK alarm that can never breach
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlwaysOkSyntheticAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-always-ok-synthetic'
      AlarmDescription: Synthetic control alarm that always evaluates to OK.
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false
        - Id: e1
          Expression: m1-m1
          Label: AlwaysZero
          ReturnData: true
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 0
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      ActionsEnabled: false
