final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions the PCI DSS automated remediation prerequisites (CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs
  log group with 1827 day retention, customer managed KMS key with rotation enabled, IAM
  role assumed by SSM Automation, and IAM role for the CloudTrail to CloudWatch Logs
  integration) together with nine AWS Systems Manager Automation remediation documents
  (CloudTrail trail encryption, KMS key rotation, CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs integration,
  IAM account password policy, trail log file validation, default security group rule
  revocation, security group deletion, unused Elastic IP release, and CodeBuild credential
  environment variable removal). All reusable artifacts are exported for consumption by
  custom AWS Config conformance packs.

Parameters:
  ResourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: pci-dss
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,18}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Must be 3-20 characters long, contain only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens,
      and must begin and end with a letter or a number.

Resources:

  ###############################################################################
  # Prerequisites
  ###############################################################################

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-cloudtrail-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 1827
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RemediationKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer managed KMS key used by the ${ResourcePrefix} PCI DSS remediation automations'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToEncryptTrailLogFiles
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  RemediationKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ResourcePrefix}-remediation-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref RemediationKmsKey

  SsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-ssm-automation-role'
      Description: Role assumed by the PCI DSS Systems Manager Automation remediation documents.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmAutomationToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-cloudtrail-cloudwatch-logs-role'
      Description: Role that CloudTrail assumes to deliver trail events to CloudWatch Logs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-cloudtrail-cloudwatch-logs-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudTrailCreateLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: CloudTrailCreateLogStreamAndPutLogEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${CloudTrailLogGroup}:log-stream:*'
              - Sid: CloudTrailDescribeLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Automation document 1 - encrypt a trail and integrate it with CloudWatch Logs
  ###############################################################################

  EncryptCloudTrailTrailDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-EncryptCloudTrailTrail'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Encrypts the specified CloudTrail trail with the supplied customer managed KMS
          key and integrates the trail with the supplied CloudWatch Logs log group.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to encrypt.
          KmsKeyId:
            type: String
            description: ARN or key ID of the customer managed KMS key used to encrypt trail log files.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to deliver events to CloudWatch Logs.
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailEncryptionAndCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Encrypts the trail with the supplied KMS key and enables CloudWatch Logs delivery.
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{TrailName}}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{KmsKeyId}}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn}}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{CloudWatchLogsRoleArn}}'
          - name: VerifyTrailCloudWatchLogsIntegration
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            description: Confirms the trail reports the requested CloudWatch Logs log group.
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: GetTrail
              Name: '{{TrailName}}'
              PropertySelector: '$.Trail.CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn'
              DesiredValues:
                - '{{CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn}}'
            isEnd: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Automation document 2 - enable KMS key rotation
  ###############################################################################

  EnableKmsKeyRotationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-EnableKmsKeyRotation'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables automatic rotation for the specified customer managed KMS key and
          verifies that key rotation is enabled.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: ARN or key ID of the KMS key for which automatic rotation is enabled.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Turns on automatic rotation for the KMS key.
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{KeyId}}'
          - name: VerifyKeyRotationEnabled
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            description: Confirms the KMS key reports key rotation as enabled.
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: GetKeyRotationStatus
              KeyId: '{{KeyId}}'
              PropertySelector: '$.KeyRotationEnabled'
              DesiredValues:
                - 'true'
            isEnd: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Automation document 3 - integrate a trail with CloudWatch Logs
  ###############################################################################

  EnableCloudTrailCloudWatchLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-EnableCloudTrailCloudWatchLogs'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Integrates the specified CloudTrail trail with the supplied CloudWatch Logs log
          group. Only the CloudWatch Logs properties are updated so that every other trail
          setting is preserved.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to integrate with CloudWatch Logs.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to deliver events to CloudWatch Logs.
        mainSteps:
          - name: IntegrateTrailWithCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Sets the CloudWatch Logs log group and role on the trail.
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{TrailName}}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn}}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{CloudWatchLogsRoleArn}}'
          - name: VerifyTrailCloudWatchLogsIntegration
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            description: Confirms the trail reports the requested CloudWatch Logs log group.
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: GetTrail
              Name: '{{TrailName}}'
              PropertySelector: '$.Trail.CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn'
              DesiredValues:
                - '{{CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn}}'
            isEnd: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Automation document 4 - account IAM password policy
  ###############################################################################

  UpdateIamPasswordPolicyDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-UpdateIamPasswordPolicy'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Updates the account IAM password policy to enforce a minimum length of 14
          characters, upper case, lower case, numeric and symbol characters, password
          expiry with a maximum age of 90 days, and prevention of the reuse of the last 24
          passwords. Note on the HardExpiry / AllowUsersToChangePassword interaction: when
          HardExpiry is true a user whose password has expired cannot change it themselves
          and an administrator must reset it; AllowUsersToChangePassword only permits a
          user to change a password that has not yet expired.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AllowUsersToChangePassword:
            type: String
            description: >-
              Whether IAM users are allowed to change their own password. Set to false to
              require an administrator to change every password.
            default: 'true'
            allowedValues:
              - 'true'
              - 'false'
          HardExpiry:
            type: String
            description: >-
              Whether an expired password can be changed by the user. When true, the user
              cannot change an expired password and an administrator must reset it.
            default: 'true'
            allowedValues:
              - 'true'
              - 'false'
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Applies the PCI DSS compliant account password policy.
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: '{{AllowUsersToChangePassword}}'
              ExpirePasswords: true
              HardExpiry: '{{HardExpiry}}'
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24
          - name: VerifyPasswordPolicyMinimumLength
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            description: Confirms the account password policy requires a minimum length of 14 characters.
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: GetAccountPasswordPolicy
              PropertySelector: '$.PasswordPolicy.MinimumPasswordLength'
              DesiredValues:
                - '14'
            isEnd: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Automation document 5 - trail log file validation, multi-region, CloudWatch Logs
  ###############################################################################

  EnableTrailLogFileValidationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-EnableTrailLogFileValidation'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables log file validation on the specified CloudTrail trail while ensuring the
          trail is multi-region and delivers events to the supplied CloudWatch Logs log
          group.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail on which log file validation is enabled.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives the trail events.
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to deliver events to CloudWatch Logs.
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableLogFileValidationAndCloudWatchLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Enables log file validation, multi-region logging and CloudWatch Logs delivery.
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{TrailName}}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn}}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{CloudWatchLogsRoleArn}}'
          - name: VerifyLogFileValidationEnabled
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            description: Confirms the trail status reports log file validation as enabled.
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: GetTrailStatus
              Name: '{{TrailName}}'
              PropertySelector: '$.LogFileValidationEnabled'

          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Automation document 6 - revoke all rules on a default security group
  ###############################################################################

  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Revokes every inbound and outbound rule on the specified default security group.
          The automation fails if the supplied group is not the default security group of
          its VPC.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the default security group whose rules are revoked.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DescribeSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Reads the current inbound and outbound rules of the security group.
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
              GroupIds:
                - '{{GroupId}}'
            outputs:
              - Name: GroupName
                Selector: '$.SecurityGroups[0].GroupName'
                Type: String
              - Name: VpcId
                Selector: '$.SecurityGroups[0].VpcId'
                Type: String
              - Name: IngressPermissions
                Selector: '$.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions'
                Type: MapList
              - Name: EgressPermissions
                Selector: '$.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissionsEgress'
                Type: MapList
          - name: AssertDefaultSecurityGroup
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            description: Fails the automation when the supplied group is not the default security group.
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
              GroupIds:
                - '{{GroupId}}'
              PropertySelector: '$.SecurityGroups[0].GroupName'
              DesiredValues:
                - 'default'
          - name: RevokeSecurityGroupIngressRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Revokes every inbound rule found on the default security group.
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              GroupId: '{{GroupId}}'
              IpPermissions: '{{DescribeSecurityGroup.IngressPermissions}}'
          - name: RevokeSecurityGroupEgressRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Revokes every outbound rule found on the default security group.
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              GroupId: '{{GroupId}}'
              IpPermissions: '{{DescribeSecurityGroup.EgressPermissions}}'
          - name: DescribeSecurityGroupAfterRevocation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Re-reads the security group rules after revocation.
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeSecurityGroups
              GroupIds:
                - '{{GroupId}}'
            outputs:
              - Name: IngressPermissions
                Selector: '$.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions'
                Type: MapList
              - Name: EgressPermissions
                Selector: '$.SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissionsEgress'
                Type: MapList
          - name: VerifySecurityGroupRulesRevoked
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Confirms that no inbound or outbound rules remain on the security group.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: verify_rules_revoked
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: '{{GroupId}}'
                IngressPermissions: '{{DescribeSecurityGroupAfterRevocation.IngressPermissions}}'
                EgressPermissions: '{{DescribeSecurityGroupAfterRevocation.EgressPermissions}}'
              Script: |-
                def verify_rules_revoked(events, context):
                    group_id = events['GroupId']
                    ingress = events.get('IngressPermissions') or []
                    egress = events.get('EgressPermissions') or []
                    if ingress or egress:
                        raise Exception(
                            'Security group {} still has {} inbound and {} outbound rules.'.format(
                                group_id, len(ingress), len(egress)
                            )
                        )
                    return {
                        'GroupId': group_id,
                        'IngressRuleCount': 0,
                        'EgressRuleCount': 0
                    }
            isEnd: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Automation document 7 - delete a security group
  ###############################################################################

  DeleteSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-DeleteSecurityGroup'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Deletes the security group identified by the runtime supplied group ID. The
          automation never targets security groups created by this template; it only
          operates on the supplied GroupId.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the security group to delete.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteTargetSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Deletes the security group identified by GroupId.
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: '{{GroupId}}'
          - name: VerifySecurityGroupDeleted
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Confirms the security group no longer exists.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: verify_group_deleted
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: '{{GroupId}}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def verify_group_deleted(events, context):
                    group_id = events['GroupId']
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    try:
                        response = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])
                    except ClientError as error:
                        if error.response['Error']['Code'] == 'InvalidGroup.NotFound':
                            return {'GroupId': group_id, 'Deleted': True}
                        raise
                    if response.get('SecurityGroups'):
                        raise Exception('Security group {} still exists.'.format(group_id))
                    return {'GroupId': group_id, 'Deleted': True}
            isEnd: true
      Tags:

          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Automation document 8 - release an unused Elastic IP address
  ###############################################################################

  ReleaseUnusedElasticIpDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-ReleaseUnusedElasticIp'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Releases the specified Elastic IP address after confirming that the address
          exists and is not associated with any resource. The automation aborts with a
          clear error when the address is still associated.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Allocation ID of the Elastic IP address to release.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DescribeElasticIpAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Confirms the Elastic IP address exists and reads its association state.
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeAddresses
              AllocationIds:
                - '{{AllocationId}}'
            outputs:
              - Name: Addresses
                Selector: '$.Addresses'
                Type: MapList
          - name: ValidateElasticIpIsUnassociated
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Fails the automation when the Elastic IP address is still associated.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: validate_unassociated
              InputPayload:
                AllocationId: '{{AllocationId}}'
                Addresses: '{{DescribeElasticIpAddress.Addresses}}'
              Script: |-
                def validate_unassociated(events, context):
                    allocation_id = events['AllocationId']
                    addresses = events.get('Addresses') or []
                    if not addresses:
                        raise Exception(
                            'Elastic IP allocation {} was not found in this account and Region.'.format(
                                allocation_id
                            )
                        )
                    address = addresses[0]
                    association_id = address.get('AssociationId')
                    if association_id:
                        raise Exception(
                            'Elastic IP {} is still associated (association ID {}). '
                            'Disassociate the address before releasing it.'.format(
                                address.get('PublicIp', allocation_id), association_id
                            )
                        )
                    return {
                        'AllocationId': address.get('AllocationId', allocation_id),
                        'PublicIp': address.get('PublicIp', ''),
                        'Unassociated': True
                    }
          - name: ReleaseElasticIpAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Releases the unassociated Elastic IP address.
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{AllocationId}}'
          - name: VerifyElasticIpReleased
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Confirms the Elastic IP allocation no longer exists in the account.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: verify_released
              InputPayload:
                AllocationId: '{{AllocationId}}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                def verify_released(events, context):
                    allocation_id = events['AllocationId']
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    try:
                        response = ec2.describe_addresses(AllocationIds=[allocation_id])
                    except ClientError as error:
                        if error.response['Error']['Code'] in (
                            'InvalidAllocationID.NotFound',
                            'InvalidAddress.NotFound'
                        ):
                            return {'AllocationId': allocation_id, 'Released': True}
                        raise
                    if response.get('Addresses'):
                        raise Exception(
                            'Elastic IP allocation {} still exists after release.'.format(allocation_id)
                        )
                    return {'AllocationId': allocation_id, 'Released': True}
            isEnd: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ###############################################################################
  # Automation document 9 - remove CodeBuild credential environment variables
  ###############################################################################

  RemoveCodeBuildCredentialsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourcePrefix}-RemoveCodeBuildCredentials'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Removes the AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables
          from the specified CodeBuild project while preserving every other environment
          variable and every other project property.
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project whose credential environment variables are removed.
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetProjectDefinition
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Retrieves the current CodeBuild project definition.
            inputs:
              Service: codebuild
              Api: BatchGetProjects
              Names:
                - '{{ProjectName}}'
            outputs:
              - Name: EnvironmentVariables
                Selector: '$.projects[0].environment.environmentVariables'
                Type: MapList
              - Name: ServiceRole
                Selector: '$.projects[0].serviceRole'
                Type: String
          - name: RemoveCredentialEnvironmentVariables
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Filters out only the two credential variables and updates the project environment.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: remove_credentials
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ProjectName}}'
                EnvironmentVariables: '{{GetProjectDefinition.EnvironmentVariables}}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                BLOCKED_VARIABLES = ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')

                def remove_credentials(events, context):
                    project_name = events['ProjectName']
                    retrieved_variables = events.get('EnvironmentVariables') or []
                    codebuild = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    projects = codebuild.batch_get_projects(names=[project_name]).get('projects', [])
                    if not projects:
                        raise Exception('CodeBuild project {} was not found.'.format(project_name))
                    environment = projects[0].get('environment', {})
                    variables = environment.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    removed = [
                        variable.get('name')
                        for variable in variables
                        if variable.get('name') in BLOCKED_VARIABLES
                    ]
                    if not removed:
                        return {
                            'ProjectName': project_name,
                            'RemovedVariables': [],
                            'RetrievedVariableCount': len(retrieved_variables)
                        }
                    environment['environmentVariables'] = [
                        variable
                        for variable in variables
                        if variable.get('name') not in BLOCKED_VARIABLES
                    ]
                    codebuild.update_project(name=project_name, environment=environment)
                    return {
                        'ProjectName': project_name,
                        'RemovedVariables': removed,
                        'RetrievedVariableCount': len(retrieved_variables)
                    }
          - name: GetUpdatedProjectDefinition
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: Re-reads the CodeBuild project definition after the update.
            inputs:
              Service: codebuild
              Api: BatchGetProjects
              Names:
                - '{{ProjectName}}'
            outputs:
              - Name: EnvironmentVariables
                Selector: '$.projects[0].environment.environmentVariables'
                Type: MapList
          - name: VerifyCredentialEnvironmentVariablesRemoved
            action: aws:executeScript
            description: Confirms that neither credential environment variable remains on the project.
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: verify_removal
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ProjectName}}'
                EnvironmentVariables: '{{GetUpdatedProjectDefinition.EnvironmentVariables}}'
              Script: |-
                BLOCKED_VARIABLES = ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')

                def verify_removal(events, context):
                    variables = events.get('EnvironmentVariables') or []
                    remaining = sorted(
                        variable.get('name')
                        for variable in variables
                        if variable.get('name') in BLOCKED_VARIABLES
                    )
                    if remaining:
                        raise Exception(
                            'CodeBuild project {} still defines the credential environment '
                            'variables: {}.'.format(events['ProjectName'], ', '.join(remaining))
                        )
                    return {
                        'ProjectName': events['ProjectName'],
                        'Removed': True,
                        'RemainingVariableNames': sorted(
                            variable.get('name') for variable in variables
                        )
                    }
            isEnd: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: Compliance
          Value: PCI-DSS
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudWatch Logs telemetry monitoring for Claude Desktop (CoWork) usage. Creates a
  CloudWatch Logs log group for CoWork telemetry events, dual-schema CloudWatch Logs metric
  filters (local agent mode schema and Claude Code for Desktop schema) that publish a single
  shared metric family (InputTokens, OutputTokens, CacheReadTokens, CacheCreationTokens,
  EstimatedCost, SessionTurns) into the CoWork/Telemetry namespace, and a CloudWatch
  dashboard with totals, trends, average cost per turn, per-user breakdowns, active-user
  count and a recent raw events table. Deployable end-to-end in a greenfield account: every
  resource the template depends on is defined inside this template.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /cowork/telemetry
    Description: >-
      Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives Claude Desktop (CoWork) telemetry
      events.
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: CoWork-Telemetry-Dashboard
    Description: >-
      Name of the CloudWatch dashboard that displays the CoWork telemetry metrics.
  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: >-
      Region used only to populate the region field of dashboard widget metric and log
      references. It is never used to create or look up resources in another region.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: >-
      Number of days that CoWork telemetry log events are retained in CloudWatch Logs.

Resources:

  CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Local agent mode schema (aggregate, dimensionless metrics)
  # Expected event shape:
  # {
  #   "schema_version": "cowork.local-agent.v1",
  #   "session_id": "...", "user_id": "alice@example.com",
  #   "usage": { "input_tokens": 1, "output_tokens": 1,
  #              "cache_read_input_tokens": 1, "cache_creation_input_tokens": 1 },
  #   "estimated_cost_usd": 0.01, "session_turns": 3
  # }
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  LocalAgentInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema_version = "cowork.local-agent.v1" && $.usage.input_tokens = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: '$.usage.input_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          DefaultValue: 0

  LocalAgentOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema_version = "cowork.local-agent.v1" && $.usage.output_tokens = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: '$.usage.output_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          DefaultValue: 0

  LocalAgentCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema_version = "cowork.local-agent.v1" && $.usage.cache_read_input_tokens = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: '$.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          DefaultValue: 0

  LocalAgentCacheCreationTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema_version = "cowork.local-agent.v1" && $.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: '$.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          DefaultValue: 0

  LocalAgentEstimatedCostFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema_version = "cowork.local-agent.v1" && $.estimated_cost_usd = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CoWork/Telemetry
          MetricName: EstimatedCost
          MetricValue: '$.estimated_cost_usd'
          Unit: 'None'
          DefaultValue: 0

  LocalAgentSessionTurnsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkTelemetryLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.schema_version = "cowork.local-agent.v1" && $.session_turns = * }'
      MetricTransformations:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS CDK bootstrap environment. Provisions an encrypted, versioned
  and HTTPS-only S3 bucket for file assets, an immutable and scan-on-push ECR
  repository for container assets (created when ImageAssetRepositoryName is
  supplied), a KMS key (or reuse of an existing key) for asset encryption, the CDK
  bootstrap IAM roles (file publishing, image publishing, account lookup,
  deployment action and CloudFormation execution) and an SSM parameter that
  records the bootstrap version. Every named resource is suffixed with the
  Qualifier so that several bootstrap stacks can coexist in the same AWS account
  and region.

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 10
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9]{1,10}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-10 lowercase alphanumeric characters.
    Description: >-
      Short identifier appended to every bootstrapped resource name so that
      multiple CDK bootstrap stacks can coexist in the same account and region.

  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      (Optional) Comma separated list of external AWS account IDs that are allowed
      to assume the bootstrap roles in this account. Leave empty to trust only the
      current account.

  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      (Optional) Comma separated list of managed policy ARNs that grant the
      permissions required to deploy CDK applications. Attached to the
      CloudFormation execution role and to the deployment action role.

  FileAssetBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      (Optional) Explicit name for the S3 bucket that stores file assets. Leave
      empty to generate a name from the account ID, region and qualifier.

  ImageAssetRepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      (Optional) Explicit name for the ECR repository that stores container
      assets. The repository is only created when a name is provided.

  ExistingKmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      (Optional) ARN of an existing KMS key used for asset encryption instead of
      creating a new key.

  CreateNewKmsKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Create a new KMS key for asset bucket encryption.

  AssetBucketVersioned:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Enable versioning on the file asset bucket.

  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "21"
    Description: CDK bootstrap version recorded in the SSM parameter.

Conditions:
  CreateNewKmsKey: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewKmsKey, "true"]
  UseExistingKmsKey: !And
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateNewKmsKey, "false"]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExistingKmsKeyArn, ""]]
  UseFileAssetBucketName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref FileAssetBucketName, ""]]
  UseImageAssetRepositoryName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ImageAssetRepositoryName, ""]]
  HaveTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref TrustedAccounts], ""]]
  HaveCloudFormationExecutionPolicies: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies], ""]]
  HaveAssetBucketVersioned: !Equals [!Ref AssetBucketVersioned, "true"]

Resources:

  ############################################################################
  # Encryption key for the file asset bucket                                  #
  ############################################################################
  FileAssetBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKmsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "CDK bootstrap asset encryption key (qualifier: ${Qualifier})"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: !Sub "${Qualifier}-cdk-bootstrap-key-policy"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowBootstrapRolesToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: cdk-bootstrap-qualifier
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  FileAssetBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateNewKmsKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${Qualifier}-cdk-bootstrap"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetBucketKey

  ############################################################################
  # File asset bucket                                                        #
  ############################################################################
  FileAssetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - UseFileAssetBucketName
        - !Ref FileAssetBucketName
        - !Sub "${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}-${Qualifier}-assets"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - CreateNewKmsKey
                - !Ref FileAssetBucketKey
                - !If
                  - UseExistingKmsKey
                  - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyArn
                  - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      VersioningConfiguration: !If
        - HaveAssetBucketVersioned
        - Status: Enabled
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: AbortIncompleteMultipartUploads
            Status: Enabled
            AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload:
              DaysAfterInitiation: 1
          - !If
            - HaveAssetBucketVersioned
            - Id: NoncurrentVersionRetention
              Status: Enabled
              NoncurrentVersionTransitions:
                - StorageClass: GLACIER
                  TransitionInDays: 90
              NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
                NoncurrentDays: 365
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: cdk-bootstrap-qualifier
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  FileAssetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref FileAssetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Id: !Sub "${Qualifier}-cdk-bootstrap-bucket-policy"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyNonSecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  ############################################################################
  # Container asset repository                                               #
  ############################################################################
  ImageAssetRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Condition: UseImageAssetRepositoryName
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref ImageAssetRepositoryName
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      RepositoryPolicyText:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCurrentAccountPushPull
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:PutImage
              - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
              - ecr:UploadLayerPart
              - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
              - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              - ecr:DescribeImages
          - !If
            - HaveTrustedAccounts
            - Sid: AllowTrustedAccountsPushPull
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action:
                - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                - ecr:BatchGetImage
                - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                - ecr:PutImage
                - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                - ecr:DescribeRepositories
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  aws:PrincipalAccount: !Ref TrustedAccounts
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: cdk-bootstrap-qualifier
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  ############################################################################
  # IAM roles                                                                #
  ############################################################################
  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: !Sub "CDK bootstrap role that publishes file assets for qualifier ${Qualifier}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCurrentAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
          - !If
            - HaveTrustedAccounts
            - Sid: AllowTrustedAccounts
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
                - sts:TagSession
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  aws:PrincipalAccount: !Ref TrustedAccounts
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FileAssetBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ObjectLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: BucketLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                Resource: !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
              - Sid: KmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKmsKey
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetBucketKey.Arn
                  - !If [UseExistingKmsKey, !Ref ExistingKmsKeyArn, "*"]
      Tags:
        - Key: cdk-bootstrap-qualifier
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: !Sub "CDK bootstrap role that publishes container assets for qualifier ${Qualifier}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCurrentAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
          - !If
            - HaveTrustedAccounts
            - Sid: AllowTrustedAccounts
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
                - sts:TagSession
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  aws:PrincipalAccount: !Ref TrustedAccounts
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageAssetRepositoryAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: RepositoryAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:DescribeImages
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                Resource: !If
                  - UseImageAssetRepositoryName
                  - !GetAtt ImageAssetRepository.Arn
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*"
              - Sid: AuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: cdk-bootstrap-qualifier
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-lookup-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: !Sub "CDK bootstrap role used for cross account and environment lookups for qualifier ${Qualifier}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCurrentAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
          - !If
            - HaveTrustedAccounts
            - Sid: AllowTrustedAccounts
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
                - sts:TagSession
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  aws:PrincipalAccount: !Ref TrustedAccounts
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: cdk-bootstrap-qualifier
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-deploy-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: !Sub "CDK bootstrap role that performs deployment actions for qualifier ${Qualifier}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCurrentAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
          - !If
            - HaveTrustedAccounts
            - Sid: AllowTrustedAccounts
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
              Action:
                - sts:AssumeRole
                - sts:TagSession
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  aws:PrincipalAccount: !Ref TrustedAccounts
            - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HaveCloudFormationExecutionPolicies
        - !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeploymentActionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssumeCloudFormationExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-*"
              - Sid: CloudFormationReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListChangeSets
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: FileAssetReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: ImageAssetReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: KmsDecryptAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKmsKey
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetBucketKey.Arn
                  - !If [UseExistingKmsKey, !Ref ExistingKmsKeyArn, "*"]
      Tags:
        - Key: cdk-bootstrap-qualifier
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "cdk-${Qualifier}-cfn-exec-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: !Sub "CDK bootstrap role assumed by CloudFormation to deploy CDK applications for qualifier ${Qualifier}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudFormation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - HaveCloudFormationExecutionPolicies
        - !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudFormationDeploymentPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudFormationActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                  - cloudformation:ListChangeSets
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: FileAssetAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${FileAssetBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: ImageAssetReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: KmsDecryptAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKmsKey
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetBucketKey.Arn
                  - !If [UseExistingKmsKey, !Ref ExistingKmsKeyArn, "*"]
              - Sid: PassRoleToCloudFormationOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: cdk-bootstrap-qualifier
          Value: !Ref Qualifier

  ############################################################################
  # Bootstrap version tracking                                               #
  ############################################################################
  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/cdk-bootstrap/${Qualifier}/version"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
      Description: !Sub "CDK bootstrap version for qualifier ${Qualifier}"
      Tags:
        cdk-bootstrap-qualifier: !Ref Qualifier

Outputs:
  FileAssetBucketName:
    Description: Name of the CDK bootstrap file asset bucket.
    Value: !Ref FileAssetBucket

  FileAssetBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the CDK bootstrap file asset bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt FileAssetBucket.Arn

  AssetBucketKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the file asset bucket.
    Value: !If
      - CreateNewKmsKey
      - !GetAtt FileAssetBucketKey.Arn
      - !Ref ExistingKmsKeyArn

  AssetBucketKmsKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the KMS key created for the file asset bucket (empty when an existing key is used).
    Value: !If
      - CreateNewKmsKey
      - !Sub "alias/${Qualifier}-cdk-bootstrap"
      - ""

  ImageAssetRepositoryName:
    Description: Name of the CDK bootstrap container asset repository.
    Value: !If
      - UseImageAssetRepositoryName
      - !Ref ImageAssetRepository
      - ""

  ImageAssetRepositoryUri:
    Description: URI of the CDK bootstrap container asset repository.
    Value: !If
      - UseImageAssetRepositoryName
      - !GetAtt ImageAssetRepository.RepositoryUri
      - ""

  FilePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the file publishing role.
    Value: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn

  ImagePublishingRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the image publishing role.
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn

  LookupRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the account lookup role.
    Value: !GetAtt LookupRole.Arn

  DeploymentActionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the deployment action role.
    Value: !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn

  CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudFormation execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn

  BootstrapVersionParameterName:
    Description: Name of the SSM parameter that records the bootstrap version.
    Value: !Ref BootstrapVersionParameter

  BootstrapVersion:
    Description: CDK bootstrap version recorded in SSM.
    Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Self-contained AWS Service Catalog ML workshop environment with two portfolios, seven products, one dedicated launch role plus launch role constraint per product, and two end-user roles. Greenfield deployment means no pre-existing VPCs, subnets, roles, buckets, KMS keys, secrets or SSM parameters are required; every dependency is created by this stack or by the nested templates loaded from RootS3Url.'

Parameters:
  RootS3Url:
    Type: String
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
    AllowedPattern: '^https://[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+\.s3([.-][a-zA-Z0-9-]+)*\.amazonaws\.com(\.cn)?(/[a-zA-Z0-9._/-]*)?$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Must be an Amazon S3 HTTPS URL such as https://<bucket>.s3.<region>.amazonaws.com/<prefix>.'
    Description: 'Root Amazon S3 HTTPS URL (no trailing slash) that holds the nested workshop templates. Used only as the base of each product''s provisioning artifact URL.'
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: user-1
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 21
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 'Lower case letters, digits and hyphens only, must start with a letter or digit, 21 characters or fewer.'
    Description: 'Short unique prefix applied to every portfolio, product, role and output name so several attendees can deploy in parallel in one account.'

Resources:
  # Shared managed policies attached to the launch roles (kept out of the roles to avoid duplicating large blocks).
  LaunchRoleStackAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-LaunchRoleStackAccessPolicy'
      Description: 'CloudFormation stack administration actions used by every Service Catalog launch role.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageProvisioningStacks
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ['cloudformation:CreateStack', 'cloudformation:UpdateStack', 'cloudformation:DeleteStack', 'cloudformation:DescribeStacks', 'cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents', 'cloudformation:DescribeStackResources', 'cloudformation:DescribeStackResource', 'cloudformation:DescribeStackDriftDetectionStatus', 'cloudformation:GetTemplate', 'cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary', 'cloudformation:ListStackResources', 'cloudformation:ListStacks', 'cloudformation:ValidateTemplate', 'cloudformation:CreateChangeSet', 'cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet', 'cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet', 'cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet', 'cloudformation:ListChangeSets']
            Resource: '*'
  LaunchRolePassRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-LaunchRolePassRolePolicy'
      Description: 'Lets the launch roles pass workshop roles to Service Catalog only.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PassWorkshopRolesToServiceCatalogOnly
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${EnvironmentPrefix}-*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals: {iam:PassedToService: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com}
  LaunchRoleKmsUsagePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-LaunchRoleKmsUsagePolicy'
      Description: 'Lets the SageMaker and third-party model launch roles use workshop KMS keys.'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: UseWorkshopKmsKeys
            Effect: Allow
            Action: ['kms:DescribeKey', 'kms:CreateGrant', 'kms:Encrypt', 'kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey', 'kms:ReEncryptFrom', 'kms:ReEncryptTo']
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*'

  # Portfolios (retained so shares, associations and principals survive stack deletion).
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} ML Workshop Admin Portfolio'
      Description: !Sub 'Administrator portfolio for the ${EnvironmentPrefix} machine learning workshop.'
      ProviderName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} ML Workshop Platform Team'
      Tags:
        - {Key: workshop, Value: ml-workshop}
  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} ML Workshop End User Portfolio'
      Description: !Sub 'End user portfolio for the ${EnvironmentPrefix} machine learning workshop.'
      ProviderName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} ML Workshop Platform Team'
      Tags:
        - {Key: workshop, Value: ml-workshop}

  # Products: each has one provisioning artifact loaded from ${RootS3Url}/${EnvironmentPrefix}/<template>.yaml.
  VpcProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc-private-subnets-and-endpoints'
      Description: !Sub 'Workshop VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints for ${EnvironmentPrefix}.'
      Owner: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} ML Workshop Platform Team'
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc-private-subnets-and-endpoints-v1'
          Description: Initial version.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3Url}/${EnvironmentPrefix}/vpc-private-subnets-and-endpoints.yaml'
      Tags:
        - {Key: workshop, Value: ml-workshop}
  IamKmsS3Product:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-iam-roles-kms-keys-s3-buckets'
      Description: !Sub 'Workshop IAM roles, KMS keys and S3 buckets for ${EnvironmentPrefix}.'
      Owner: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} ML Workshop Platform Team'
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-iam-roles-kms-keys-s3-buckets-v1'
          Description: Initial version.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3Url}/${EnvironmentPrefix}/iam-roles-kms-keys-s3-buckets.yaml'
      Tags:
        - {Key: workshop, Value: ml-workshop}
  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-aws-data-exchange'
      Description: !Sub 'Subscribes ${EnvironmentPrefix} to the workshop AWS Data Exchange data set.'
      Owner: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} ML Workshop Platform Team'
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-aws-data-exchange-v1'
          Description: Initial version.
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3Url}/${EnvironmentPrefix}/aws-data-exchange.yaml'
      Tags:
        - {Key: workshop, Value: ml-workshop}
  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-workshop-infrastructure'
