AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Dual-stack (IPv4 and IPv6) VPC network for a single staging or production environment.
  Provisions public and private subnets, an internet gateway, an egress-only internet gateway,
  an optional NAT gateway with Elastic IP, public and private network ACLs, a cluster placement
  group, and a DHCP options set, and exports the VPC, subnet, and private route table identifiers
  for use by other stacks.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment to provision; selects the VPC, subnet, and domain name configuration.
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging

  EnableNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Set to "true" to create a NAT gateway (and Elastic IP) for private subnet IPv4 egress.
      Set to "false" when a bastion host already provides that egress role.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'false'

Mappings:
  EnvConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.0.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.0.0.0/20
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.0.16.0/20
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.0.32.0/20
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.0.48.0/20
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.0.64.0/20
      DomainName: staging.example.com
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.1.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.1.0.0/20
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.1.16.0/20
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.1.32.0/20
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.1.48.0/20
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.1.64.0/20
      DomainName: production.example.com

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-igw
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet1Cidr]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-public-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet2Cidr]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-public-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet3Cidr]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-public-subnet-3
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet1Cidr]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-private-subnet-1
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet2Cidr]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-private-subnet-2
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-public-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-private-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteNatIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  NatGatewayEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-nat-eip
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-nat-gateway
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${Environment}-public-nacl
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicNaclIngressHttpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: '6'
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicNaclIngressHttpIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: '6'
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicNaclIngressHttpsIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: '6'
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicNaclIngressHttpsIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: '6'
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicNaclIngressSshIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 140
      Protocol: '6'
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicNaclIngressSshIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 150
      Protocol: '6'
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicNaclIngressVpnIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 160
      Protocol: '17'
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1194
        To: 1194

  PublicNaclIngressVpnIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 170
      Protocol: '17'
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 1194
        To: 1194

  PublicNaclIngressEphemeralIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 180
      Protocol: '6'
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 1024

  PublicNaclIngressEphemeralIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 190

      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      PortRange:
        From: 1024

  PublicNaclEgressAllIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: '-1'
      RuleAction: allow

  PublicNaclEgressAllIpv6:

    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: '-1'
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      Ipv6CidrBlock: '::/0'

  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc

  PrivateNaclIngressAllIpv4:

    Properties:

    Properties:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Provisions a SageMaker Studio user profile for an MLOps engineer persona, together with a
  scoped IAM execution role for that persona and a per-user SageMaker execution role. When an
  existing SageMaker Studio domain ID is supplied the user profile is attached to that domain;
  when it is not supplied, the template creates a self-contained VPC with private subnets,
  gateway/interface VPC endpoints, a restricted security group and a VPC-only SageMaker Studio
  domain, and attaches the user profile to the newly created domain.

Parameters:
  DomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional ID of an existing SageMaker Studio domain. Leave empty to have this template
      create a new, self-contained SageMaker Studio domain with its own VPC.
  DomainSecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional security group IDs associated with the existing SageMaker Studio domain.
      Used only when DomainId is supplied.
  DomainSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional subnet IDs associated with the existing SageMaker Studio domain.
      Used only when DomainId is supplied.
  PersonaName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    Description: Persona the user profile and execution roles are provisioned for.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name used for resource naming and tagging.

Conditions:
  CreateNewDomain: !Equals [!Ref DomainId, '']
  UseExistingDomain: !Not
    - !Condition CreateNewDomain

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Self-contained networking - created only when DomainId is not supplied.
  # Subnets are private (no auto-assigned public IPs); AWS service connectivity
  # is provided through VPC endpoints rather than through the public internet.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  SageMakerVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${PersonaName}-${Environment}-sagemaker-vpc'
        - Key: PersonaName
          Value: !Ref PersonaName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${PersonaName}-${Environment}-sagemaker-subnet-1'
        - Key: PersonaName
          Value: !Ref PersonaName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${PersonaName}-${Environment}-sagemaker-subnet-2'
        - Key: PersonaName
          Value: !Ref PersonaName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${PersonaName}-${Environment}-sagemaker-rt'
        - Key: PersonaName
          Value: !Ref PersonaName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  Subnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  Subnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  DomainSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: >-
        SageMaker Studio domain security group. Permits NFS traffic to the domain EFS mount and
        HTTPS traffic to AWS service VPC endpoint ENIs inside the VPC. Egress is restricted to
        the VPC CIDR and never opens to 0.0.0.0/0.
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 2049
          ToPort: 2049
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: NFS traffic to the SageMaker Studio domain EFS mount within the VPC
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/16
          Description: >-
            HTTPS to AWS service VPC endpoint ENIs inside the VPC (S3, ECR, SageMaker API and
            runtime, CloudWatch Logs, STS, CloudWatch). AWS-managed prefix list IDs cannot be
            referenced in a greenfield template, so egress is constrained to the VPC CIDR where
            the interface endpoint elastic network interfaces reside.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${PersonaName}-${Environment}-sagemaker-domain-sg'
        - Key: PersonaName
          Value: !Ref PersonaName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DomainSecurityGroupNfsIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt DomainSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 2049
      ToPort: 2049
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt DomainSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Description: NFS traffic for SageMaker Studio domain volumes (self-referencing)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC endpoints provide the AWS service connectivity the Studio domain needs
  # without opening egress to the public internet.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt DomainSecurityGroup.GroupId

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt DomainSecurityGroup.GroupId

  SageMakerApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sagemaker.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt DomainSecurityGroup.GroupId

  SageMakerRuntimeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sagemaker.runtime'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt DomainSecurityGroup.GroupId

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt DomainSecurityGroup.GroupId

  StsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt DomainSecurityGroup.GroupId

  CloudWatchMonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt DomainSecurityGroup.GroupId

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Per-user SageMaker execution role (passed by the persona role, used by the
  # domain default user settings and by the user profile)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${PersonaName}-${Environment}-sagemaker-execution-role'
      Description: >-
        Per-user SageMaker execution role used by the MLOps engineer Studio user profile and by
        the SageMaker jobs and pipelines it launches.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerArtifactsAndContainerImages
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerArtifactBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-*/*'
              - Sid: ContainerRegistryAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:repository/*'
              - Sid: ContainerRegistryAuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: PersonaName
          Value: !Ref PersonaName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # MLOps engineer persona execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  MLOpsEngineerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${PersonaName}-${Environment}-mlops-execution-role'
      Description: >-
        Execution role for the MLOps engineer persona, scoped to SageMaker pipelines, model
        monitoring schedules, model registry, experiments and lineage, training/transform/
        processing/tuning jobs, endpoints, and owned Studio apps and spaces.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSageMakerToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PassPerUserSageMakerExecutionRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PassExecutionRoleOnlyToSageMaker
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
        - PolicyName: SageMakerPipelines
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManagePipelineExecutionsAndReadPipelines
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineParametersForExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipeline/*'
        - PolicyName: SageMakerModelMonitorAndProcessingJobs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageMonitoringSchedules
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Self-contained SageMaker Studio domain (created only when DomainId is empty).
  # AppNetworkAccessType is VpcOnly so all app traffic stays on the VPC endpoints
  # and never requires unrestricted internet egress.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  SageMakerDomain:

    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Sub '${PersonaName}-${Environment}-studio-domain'
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: VpcOnly
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups:
          - !GetAtt DomainSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${PersonaName}-${Environment}-studio-domain'
        - Key: PersonaName
          Value: !Ref PersonaName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # MLOps engineer SageMaker Studio user profile
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  MLOpsEngineerUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If
        - CreateNewDomain
        - !Ref SageMakerDomain
        - !Ref DomainId
      UserProfileName: !Sub '${PersonaName}-${Environment}'
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !If
          - CreateNewDomain
          - - !GetAtt DomainSecurityGroup.GroupId
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: PersonaName
          Value: !Ref PersonaName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cross-region failover health monitoring for the Remittance application. This
  stack provisions the Remittance API Gateway REST API, the GetRemittances and
  CreateRemittance Lambda functions, the dbcluster1-instance1 RDS instance and
  the supporting networking and IAM resources, then creates the underlying
  CloudWatch metric alarms and the API Gateway Health, Lambda Health and RDS
  Health composite alarms.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: >-
      Environment name applied as a tag to every resource created by this stack.

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # Networking (VPC, subnets, internet gateway, route table)
  ###########################################################################

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  Subnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

        - Key: Environment

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function

      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Architectures:
        - x86_64
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"remittances": []}),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function

      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Architectures:
        - x86_64
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json


          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 201,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps({"status": "created"}),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  HealthTopicKey:

      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowSnsToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  QuickSight admin console monitoring and data extraction pipeline. Creates seven AWS Glue jobs
  (five Python shell jobs on Glue 3.0 and two Spark ETL jobs on Glue 5.0 with G.1X workers), one
  scheduled trigger per job running every three hours, a private output S3 bucket, a private Glue
  script S3 bucket, a customer managed KMS key protecting both buckets, five CloudWatch metric
  streams and five dedicated Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams, all executing under a single
  shared IAM role.

Parameters:

  ScriptKeyPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: 'scripts/'
    Description: >-
      S3 key prefix inside the Glue script bucket that holds the seven Glue job scripts.
      Must end with a forward slash (default: scripts/).
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9!_.*()/-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 key prefix made of safe characters.

Resources:

  ###########################################################################
  # KMS - customer managed key shared by both buckets
  ###########################################################################

  AdminSuiteKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Customer managed key used to encrypt the QuickSight admin suite output bucket and the
        Glue script bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: admin-suite-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  AdminSuiteKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AdminSuiteKey

  ###########################################################################
  # S3 - output bucket (Retain) and private Glue script bucket (Retain)
  ###########################################################################

  OutputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-glue-scripts-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  OutputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref OutputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: DenyAnonymousAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              'Null':
                'aws:PrincipalArn': 'true'

  ScriptBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ScriptBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: DenyAnonymousAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              'Null':
                'aws:PrincipalArn': 'true'

  ###########################################################################
  # Single shared IAM role for Glue, CloudFormation, Firehose, metric streams
  ###########################################################################

  SharedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Shared execution role for the QuickSight admin suite Glue jobs, Kinesis Data Firehose
        delivery streams and CloudWatch metric streams.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowServicePrincipalsToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3ScriptBucketRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersion'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ScriptBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${ScriptBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: S3OutputBucketReadWrite
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersion'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:AbortMultipartUpload'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:ListBucketMultipartUploads'
                  - 's3:ListMultipartUploadParts'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
        - PolicyName: KmsDataPlaneAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: QuickSightReadOnlyAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'quicksight:Describe*'
                  - 'quicksight:List*'
                  - 'quicksight:Search*'
                  - 'quicksight:Get*'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: GlueJobAndCatalogAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'glue:GetJob'
                  - 'glue:GetJobs'
                  - 'glue:GetJobRun'
                  - 'glue:GetJobRuns'
                  - 'glue:StartJobRun'
                  - 'glue:BatchStopJobRun'
                  - 'glue:GetJobBookmark'
                  - 'glue:ResetJobBookmark'
                  - 'glue:GetTrigger'
                  - 'glue:GetTriggers'
                  - 'glue:GetDatabase'
                  - 'glue:GetDatabases'
                  - 'glue:GetTable'
                  - 'glue:GetTables'
                  - 'glue:GetPartition'
                  - 'glue:GetPartitions'
                  - 'glue:GetConnection'
                  - 'glue:GetConnections'
                  - 'glue:GetCatalogImportStatus'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsWrite
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/*:*'
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchMetricsAndLogDiscovery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricData'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: FirehoseDeliveryAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'firehose:PutRecord'
                  - 'firehose:PutRecordBatch'
                  - 'firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/*'
        - PolicyName: PassRoleToGlueAndFirehose
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService':
                      - 'glue.amazonaws.com'
                      - 'firehose.amazonaws.com'

  ###########################################################################
  # Glue jobs - five Python shell jobs (Glue 3.0, Python 3.9)
  ###########################################################################

  AssetsAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Collects QuickSight asset access details.
      Role: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--python-version': '3.9'
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  AssetsMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Collects QuickSight asset metadata.
      Role: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--python-version': '3.9'
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Description: Collects QuickSight folder structure information.
      Role: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--python-version': '3.9'
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  QMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Description: Collects Amazon QuickSight Q topic metadata.
      Role: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--python-version': '3.9'
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  QAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Description: Collects Amazon QuickSight Q object access details.
      Role: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--python-version': '3.9'
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  ###########################################################################
  # Glue jobs - two Spark ETL jobs (Glue 5.0, G.1X, two workers)
  ###########################################################################

  DsPropertiesJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Description: Extracts QuickSight dataset properties.
      Role: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  DataSourcePropertiesJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Description: Extracts QuickSight data source properties.
      Role: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptKeyPrefix}etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  ###########################################################################
  # Glue triggers - one scheduled trigger per job, every three hours
  ###########################################################################

  AssetsAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_assets_access
      Description: Runs the QuickSight asset access extraction job every three hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AssetsAccessJob

  AssetsMetadataTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Description: Runs the QuickSight asset metadata extraction job every three hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AssetsMetadataJob

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Description: Runs the QuickSight folder asset extraction job every three hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob

  QMetadataTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Description: Runs the QuickSight Q topic metadata extraction job every three hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref QMetadataJob

  QAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_q_access
      Description: Runs the QuickSight Q object access extraction job every three hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref QAccessJob

  DsPropertiesTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Description: Runs the QuickSight dataset properties extraction job every three hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref DsPropertiesJob

  DataSourcePropertiesTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Description: Runs the QuickSight data source properties extraction job every three hours.
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref DataSourcePropertiesJob

  ###########################################################################
  # Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams (DirectPut -> output bucket)
  ###########################################################################

  AssetsAccessDeliveryStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: !Sub 'admin-suite-assets-access-${AWS::AccountId}'
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'assets-access/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  AssetsMetadataDeliveryStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: !Sub 'admin-suite-assets-metadata-${AWS::AccountId}'
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'assets-metadata/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  SpiceDeliveryStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: !Sub 'admin-suite-spice-${AWS::AccountId}'
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'spice/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  QuickIndexDeliveryStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: !Sub 'admin-suite-quick-index-${AWS::AccountId}'
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'quick-index/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  ActionsDeliveryStream:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: !Sub 'admin-suite-actions-${AWS::AccountId}'
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
        Prefix: 'actions/'
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5
        CompressionFormat: GZIP
        EncryptionConfiguration:
          KMSEncryptionConfig:
            AWSKMSKeyARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn

  ###########################################################################
  # CloudWatch metric streams (QuickSight metrics -> dedicated Firehose)
  ###########################################################################

  AssetsAccessMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-assets-access-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt AssetsAccessDeliveryStream.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount
            - IngestionErrorCount

  AssetsMetadataMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-assets-metadata-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt AssetsMetadataDeliveryStream.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - VisualLoadTime
            - DashboardViewLoadTime
            - DashboardViewCount
            - VisualLoadErrorCount

  SpiceMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-spice-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt SpiceDeliveryStream.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - SPICECapacityLimitInMB
            - SPICECapacityConsumedInMB

  QuickIndexMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-quick-index-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt QuickIndexDeliveryStream.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - QuickIndexDocumentCount
            - QuickIndexExtractedTextSize

  ActionsMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: quicksight-actions-metrics
      OutputFormat: json
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SharedRole.Arn
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt ActionsDeliveryStream.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - ActionInvocationError
            - ActionInvocationCount

  OutputBucketName:

  OutputBucketArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: CAPA (Cluster API Provider AWS) bootstrap IAM stack for an EKS-backed cluster - creates the CAPA control-plane, nodes, controllers and EKS cluster IAM roles, their instance profiles, and the customer managed policies required to provision and operate the cluster.

Parameters:
  ClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: capa
    Description: Name of the CAPA managed cluster, used to derive IAM resource names.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name applied as a tag to all IAM roles created by this stack.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 40

Resources:

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterName}-control-plane-role'
      Description: !Sub 'CAPA control plane role for the ${ClusterName} cluster (EC2 assumed)'
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ClusterName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  NodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterName}-nodes-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Worker node role for the ${ClusterName} cluster (EC2 assumed)'
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ClusterName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterName}-controllers-role'
      Description: !Sub 'CAPA controllers role for the ${ClusterName} cluster (EC2 and EKS pods assumed)'
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEC2AssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
          - Sid: AllowEKSAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ClusterName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  EksClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ClusterName}-eks-cluster-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Amazon EKS control plane service role for the ${ClusterName} cluster'
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEKSAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ClusterName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ClusterName}-control-plane-instance-profile'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ClusterName}-controllers-instance-profile'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ClusterName}-nodes-instance-profile'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref NodesRole

  LegacyCloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ClusterName}-legacy-cloud-provider-policy'
      Description: !Sub 'Permissions for the legacy in-tree AWS cloud provider run by the ${ClusterName} control plane'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:CreateVolume
              - ec2:DeleteVolume
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:Describe*
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
              - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:ConfigureHealthCheck
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterInstancesWithLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterInstancesFromLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancerPolicy
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancerPolicy
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: KMS
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'

  NodeRegistrationPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ClusterName}-node-registration-policy'
      Description: !Sub 'Permissions for ${ClusterName} control plane and worker nodes to register with the cluster and pull images'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref NodesRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2NodeRegistration
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ECRImagePull
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SecretsManager
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMAgent
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
              - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
              - ec2messages:AcknowledgeMessage
              - ec2messages:DeleteMessage
              - ec2messages:FailMessage
              - ec2messages:GetEndpoint
              - ec2messages:GetMessages
              - ec2messages:SendReply
            Resource: '*'

  CapiControllerPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ClusterName}-capi-controller-policy'
      Description: !Sub 'Broad infrastructure management permissions used by the CAPA controllers for the ${ClusterName} cluster'
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2Networking
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:ModifyVpcAttribute
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:ModifySubnetAttribute
              - ec2:AssociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:DisassociateVpcCidrBlock
              - ec2:AssociateSubnetCidrBlock
              - ec2:DisassociateSubnetCidrBlock
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:DescribeNatGateways
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:DescribeAddresses
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: EC2LaunchTemplatesAndInstances
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
              - ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplate
              - ec2:DeleteLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplates
              - ec2:DescribeLaunchTemplateVersions
              - ec2:GetLaunchTemplateData
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:StartInstances
              - ec2:StopInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeImages
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AutoScaling
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:DescribePolicies
              - autoscaling:DescribeScheduledActions
              - autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
              - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
              - autoscaling:AttachInstances
              - autoscaling:DetachInstances
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ElasticLoadBalancing

            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer

              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
