AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions an AWS Glue ETL job (Shapefile → per-feature GeoJSON) plus its Glue service role, a customer managed KMS key for data encryption, and the S3 buckets used for raw GIS input, Glue scripts/temp/spark logs, and GeoJSON output.

Parameters:
  GlueJobName:
    Type: String
    Default: map-appraiser-shapefile-to-geojson-etl
    Description: Name of the AWS Glue ETL job.
  GlueScriptLocation:
    Type: String
    Default: s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/shapefile_to_geojson_etl.py
    Description: S3 URI of the Glue ETL script.
  GlueServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: MapAppraiserShapefileGlueServiceRole
    Description: Name of the IAM service role used by the Glue job.

Resources:
  GlueDataKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for encrypting Glue scripts, raw GIS data, and GeoJSON output.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowGlueServiceRoleUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${GlueServiceRoleName}"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"

  GlueDataKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/map-appraiser-glue-data
      TargetKeyId: !Ref GlueDataKmsKey

  GlueScriptsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-glue-scripts
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt GlueDataKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  RawGisBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-data-raw-gis
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt GlueDataKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  KnowledgeBaseBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: map-appraiser-data-knowledge-base
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt GlueDataKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true

  GlueScriptsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref GlueScriptsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"
          - Sid: DenyAnonymousAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalType: "Anonymous"

  RawGisBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref RawGisBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt RawGisBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${RawGisBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"
          - Sid: DenyAnonymousAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt RawGisBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${RawGisBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalType: "Anonymous"

  KnowledgeBaseBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref KnowledgeBaseBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"
          - Sid: DenyAnonymousAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalType: "Anonymous"

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref GlueServiceRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueServiceRoleCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/*:*"
        - PolicyName: GlueServiceRoleKmsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt GlueDataKmsKey.Arn
        - PolicyName: GlueServiceRoleS3ReadPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${RawGisBucket.Arn}/*"
                  - !Sub "${GlueScriptsBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RawGisBucket.Arn
                  - !GetAtt GlueScriptsBucket.Arn
        - PolicyName: GlueServiceRoleKnowledgeBaseReadWritePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "${KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt KnowledgeBaseBucket.Arn

  ShapefileToGeoJSONGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref GlueJobName
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Ref GlueScriptLocation
        PythonVersion: '3'
      GlueVersion: '4.0'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      Timeout: 2880
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      DefaultArguments:
        "--enable-metrics": "true"
        "--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log": "true"
        "--enable-spark-ui": "true"
        "--spark-event-logs-path": "s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/spark-logs/"
        "--job-bookmark-option": "job-bookmark-enable"
        "--TempDir": "s3://map-appraiser-glue-scripts/temp/"
        "--additional-python-modules": "geopandas0.14.1,shapely2.0.2,pyproj3.6.1,fiona1.9.5"

Outputs:
  GlueJobName:
    Description: Name of the created AWS Glue ETL job.
    Value: !Ref ShapefileToGeoJSONGlueJob
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-GlueJobName"
  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Glue service role.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
    Export:

  GlueScriptUploadCommand:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Account-level Amazon S3 Block Public Access enforcement stack. This template deploys an
  AWS Systems Manager Automation document that uses schema version 0.3 to call the Amazon S3
  Control PutPublicAccessBlock API for the local account (enabling BlockPublicAcls,
  BlockPublicPolicy, IgnorePublicAcls, and RestrictPublicBuckets), an IAM role that Systems
  Manager Automation assumes at execution time, an IAM role that Amazon EventBridge assumes,
  and an enabled EventBridge scheduled rule that starts the automation once per day.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by Systems Manager Automation (service principal: ssm.amazonaws.com)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SSMAutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Execution role that Systems Manager Automation assumes to enable account-level
        S3 Block Public Access.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSystemsManagerAutomationToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccountLevelBlockPublicAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AccountLevelPublicAccessBlock
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Automation document (schema version 0.3) that enforces account-level
  # S3 Block Public Access by invoking the S3 Control PutPublicAccessBlock API.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-S3AccountBlockPublicAccess'
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables the four account-level Amazon S3 Block Public Access settings
          (BlockPublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, IgnorePublicAcls, RestrictPublicBuckets)
          for the account in which the automation runs.
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: >-
              ARN of the IAM role that Systems Manager Automation assumes to call the
              Amazon S3 Control PutPublicAccessBlock API for the account.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableAccountLevelBlockPublicAccess
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: >-
              Calls the Amazon S3 Control PutPublicAccessBlock API for the local account and
              enables all four account-level Block Public Access settings.
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
            isEnd: true
        assumeRole: '{{AutomationAssumeRole}}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by Amazon EventBridge (service principal: events.amazonaws.com)
  # so the scheduled rule can start the automation on the stack's behalf.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Role that Amazon EventBridge assumes to start the account-level S3 Block Public
        Access automation.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeToAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartS3BlockPublicAccessAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartAutomationExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument}'
              - Sid: PassAutomationExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ssm.amazonaws.com

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Enabled EventBridge scheduled rule that runs the automation once per day.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3AccountBlockPublicAccessSchedule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: >-
        Runs the account-level S3 Block Public Access automation once per day.
      State: ENABLED
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 day)
      Targets:
        - Id: S3AccountBlockPublicAccessAutomationTarget
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument}'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeExecutionRole.Arn
          Input: !Sub |
            {
              "DocumentName": "${S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument}",
              "DocumentVersion": "$DEFAULT",
              "Parameters": {
                "AutomationAssumeRole": ["${SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn}"]
              }
            }

Outputs:

  SSMAutomationDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the Systems Manager Automation document that enforces account-level S3 Block Public Access.
    Value: !Ref S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument

  SSMAutomationDocumentArn:
    Description: ARN of the Systems Manager Automation document that enforces account-level S3 Block Public Access.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${S3AccountBlockPublicAccessDocument}'

  SSMAutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role that Systems Manager Automation assumes during document execution.
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationExecutionRole.Arn

  EventBridgeRuleName:
    Description: Name of the enabled EventBridge scheduled rule that starts the automation daily.
    Value: !Ref S3AccountBlockPublicAccessSchedule

  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the enabled EventBridge scheduled rule that starts the automation daily.
    Value: !GetAtt S3AccountBlockPublicAccessSchedule.Arn

  EventBridgeExecutionRoleArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Service Catalog preventive-controls test environment building a VPC, subnets, test security group, customer managed KMS key, DMS and ElastiCache subnet groups, a SageMaker execution role, and one Service Catalog launch role per product family.
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: sc-controls-test
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{3,20}$'
Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  Subnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  Subnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Service Catalog preventive-controls test security group
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
          Description: HTTPS between test resources in the VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 172.16.0.0/16
          Description: Outbound traffic to resources inside the test VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Test environment customer managed key
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Root
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: LaunchRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt AlbLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt AutoscalingLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DmsEndpointLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DmsInstanceLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DynamoDbLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EbsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EfsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElastiCacheLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElasticsearchLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt FsxLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt KinesisLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SnsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SqsLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt S3LaunchRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Services
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - dms.amazonaws.com
                - elasticache.amazonaws.com
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
                - !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                kms:ViaService:
                  - !Sub 'dms.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 'elasticache.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 'sagemaker.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                  - !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
  KmsKeyAlias:

                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig

                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint

                  - sagemaker:AddTags

              - Sid: Describes

  S3LaunchRole:

                  - s3:GetBucketTagging

                  - s3:GetObject

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless AI campaign orchestration platform on Bedrock, Step Functions, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito and HTTP API.
Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: campaign-platform
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 40
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Project name.
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MinLength: 2
    MaxLength: 20
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Environment name.
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0
    Description: Bedrock model id.
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ops@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
    Description: Alert email.
  MessagingPhoneNumberId:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    Description: SMS sender id.
  WhatsAppSenderId:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    Description: WhatsApp sender id.
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['false', 'true']
    Description: Enable vector search.
Conditions:
  EnableSemanticSearchCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, 'true']
Resources:
  CampaignKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Campaign CMK
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Root
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Logs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: Aoss
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'aoss.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Sns
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  CampaignKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CampaignKey
  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-customer-profiles'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: segment
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: SegmentIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: segment
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: customerId
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-channel-rate-limits'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: channel
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: windowKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: channel
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: windowKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  MessageDeliveryTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-message-delivery'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: status
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: StatusIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: status
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: messageId
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  CampaignAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureConnections
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: DenyUploadsWithoutKMS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                's3:x-amz-server-side-encryption': 'aws:kms'
          - Sid: DenyUploadsWithoutCMK
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub '${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                's3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id': !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-campaign-orchestration'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CampaignKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  StateMachineLogGroupPolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${EnvironmentName}-sfn-log-delivery'
      PolicyDocument: !Sub
        - |
          {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowStepFunctionsLogDelivery","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"delivery.logs.amazonaws.com"},"Action":["logs:CreateLogStream","logs:PutLogEvents"],"Resource":"${LogGroupArn}:*"}]}
        - LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
  ParseInstructionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ParseInstructionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/${BedrockModelId}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  SegmentCustomersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SegmentCustomersPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${CustomerProfilesTable.Arn}/index/*'
